items.title: Discovery, optimization, and Phase 1 evaluation of a novel, orally available GLP-1R/GIPR dual agonist.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: The efficacy and convenience of anti-diabetic and anti-obesity therapeutics have surged in recent years due to the emergence of incretin-based poly-pharmacological approaches as well as advances in the oral delivery of peptide drugs. We sought to combine both strategies in an orally deliverable dual agonist of the GLP-1 and GIP receptors.
METHODOLOGY: We designed a panel of unimolecular, fatty-acylated peptide dual agonists, which was screened for receptor potencies in cell-based assay systems. NNC0130 was selected to advance into clinical studies using both oral and subcutaneous administration.
RESULTS: NNC0130 exhibited in vitro potency comparable to semaglutide at human GLP-1R and to tirzepatide at human GIPR, with a chemical structure compatible with semi-recombinant production. Its human half-life of 76-89 hours was deemed suitable for once-daily oral administration. In a multiple-ascending dose trial in participants with overweight or obesity and with separate subcutaneous and oral cohorts, daily subcutaneous administration of NNC0130 escalating from 0.3 to 3.0 mg per dose provided a placebo-corrected mean body weight loss of 9% after 12 weeks of treatment and 12% after 15 weeks. Daily oral administration escalating from 5 to 50 mg per dose provided a placebo-corrected mean body weight loss of 4% after 12 weeks, which was not statistically significantly different from zero. The relative oral bioavailability when co-formulated with permeation enhancer salcaprozate sodium was estimated to 1.6-2.2% versus s.c. administration.
CONCLUSIONS: The modest weight lowering efficacy of orally administered NNC0130 highlights the continued challenges of low oral bioavailability of acylated peptides. However, the substantial efficacy observed with subcutaneous administration motivated advancement into Phase 2 clinical development.
items.authors: Mowery Stephanie A, Knerr Patrick J, Hjøllund Karina Rahr, Nissen Birgitte, Olsen Anette K, Wilkens Trine Levring, Jakobsen Lasse Hjort Kyneb, Hollesen Christian
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、新規経口投与可能なGLP-1R/GIPRデュアルアゴニストNNC0130の発見、最適化、および第I相評価を報告する。脂肪酸アシル化ペプチドのデュアルアゴニストパネルを設計し、細胞ベースのアッセイで受容体ポテンシーをスクリーニングした。NNC0130はヒトGLP-1Rにおいてセマグルチドに、ヒトGIPRにおいてtirzepatideに匹敵するin vitroポテンシーを示し、半減期は76〜89時間であった。過体重または肥満の被験者における複数漸増用量試験において、皮下投与（0.3〜3.0 mg/日）では12週で9%、15週で12%のプラセボ補正平均体重減少を、経口投与（5〜50 mg/日）では12週で4%のプラセボ補正平均体重減少（統計的に有意でない）を示した。経口バイオアベイラビリティは1.6〜2.2%と推定された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 皮下投与のNNC0130は15週で12%のプラセボ補正体重減少という顕著な効果を示し、第II相開発への推進を支持したが、経口投与は低バイオアベイラビリティ（1.6〜2.2%）により効果は限定的であった。
items.why_matters_ja: インクレチンベースのポリファーマコロジー戦略とペプチド薬の経口送達技術の両方を組み合わせたアプローチであり、抗肥満治療の有効性と利便性の両立という未解決課題に挑むものである。
items.study_type_ja: 第I相複数漸増用量試験（前臨床の発見・最適化を含む）
items.endpoints_ja: プラセボ補正平均体重減少率、経口バイオアベイラビリティ
items.endpoint_results_ja: 皮下投与：12週でプラセボ補正平均体重減少9%、15週で12%。経口投与：12週でプラセボ補正平均体重減少4%（ゼロとの差は統計的に有意でない）。経口バイオアベイラビリティ：salcaprozate sodiumとの共配合で皮下投与比1.6〜2.2%。

items.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease and Cardiovascular Disease: A Review.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists have transformed the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity and have more recently demonstrated clinically important effects across the cardiometabolic spectrum, including metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis, and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. Earlier cardiovascular outcome trials established reductions in major adverse cardiovascular events by way of injectable forms in patients with diabetes, while newer evidence has expanded these findings to oral semaglutide and to other patient populations. This review summarizes the hepatic, cardiovascular, and heart-failure evidence for glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists-based therapies and discusses remaining clinical uncertainties and future directions.
items.authors: Rahni Sarah, Lebovics Edward, Frishman William H, Aronow Wilbert S
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬が代謝機能異常関連脂肪肝疾患（MASLD）、代謝機能異常関連脂肪性肝炎（MASH）、および動脈硬化性心血管疾患（ASCVD）に対して臨床的に重要な効果を示していることを、肝臓・心血管・心不全のエビデンスの観点から総説したレビュー記事。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬は、注射製剤による糖尿病患者での主要心血管不良事象（MACE）減少に加え、経口セマグルチドや他の患者集団にもその効果が拡大しており、MASLD・MASH・ASCVDにまたがる心代謝スペクトラム全体で臨床的に重要な効果を示している。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の糖尿病・肥満治療からの応用拡大を背景に、肝疾患および心血管領域におけるエビデンスを統合的に整理し、残存する臨床的不確実性と今後の方向性を議論している点で、臨床開発・データ管理の観点から治療戦略の方向性を把握する上で有用である。
items.study_type_ja: 総説（Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要心血管不良事象（MACE）、肝臓関連アウトカム、心血管アウトカム、心不全アウトカム

items.title: Cardiometabolic benefits of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and dual agonists: from obesity and diabetes to heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) accounts for over half of all heart failure hospitalisations and is increasing in prevalence, largely driven by obesity and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM). Glucagon-like-peptide receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) and the dual GLP-1/GIP agonist, tirzepatide, have been shown to be safe and effective medications in the treatment of T2DM and obesity as well as in obesity-related HFpEF.
AREAS COVERED: This review summarises the pathophysiology of obesity-related HFpEF, mechanisms by which GLP-1 RAs and tirzepatide may improve symptoms and outcomes, and summarise evidence from recent randomised controlled and observational trials across the disease spectrum they have been studied in. Therapeutic implications and future research directions are also discussed. A structured literature search was performed using PubMed/MEDLINE and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) up to August 2025.
EXPERT OPINION: GLP-1 receptor agonists and tirzepatide represent a promising therapeutic advance for obesity-related HFpEF. Benefits are likely mediated through weight loss dependent and weight-loss independent mechanisms. Important uncertainties remain regarding their role in non-obese HFpEF, optimal patient selection, and their safety in HFrEF.
items.authors: Chotalia Ravi, Ghias Owais, Shah Muhammad Usman, Hills Claire Elizabeth, Ward Joanna Kate, Squires Paul Edward, Andrews Richard, Venugopal Vinod
items.summary_ja: 肥満関連HFpEF（保存型左室機能不全）の病態生理、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）およびtirzepatide（GLP-1/GIP二重作動薬）が症状・転帰を改善しうるメカニズム、および近年のランダム化比較試験・観察研究のエビデンスを概説したレビュー論文。PubMed/MEDLINEおよびCochrane CENTRALを用いて2025年8月までの構造化文献検索を実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬およびtirzepatideは肥満関連HFpEFに対する有望な治療的進歩であり、体重減少依存性および体重減少非依存性のメカニズムを介して利益をもたらすと考えられる。ただし、非肥満HFpEFにおける役割、最適な患者選定、HFrEFにおける安全性については重要な不確実性が残る。
items.why_matters_ja: HFpEFは心不全入院の半数以上を占め、肥満および2型糖尿病に牽引されて有病率が増加している。GLP-1 RAおよびtirzepatideはT2DM・肥満の治療薬として安全性・有効性が示されており、肥満関連HFpEFへの応用が期待される。

items.title: The effect of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists on bone metabolism: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized placebo-controlled trials of predominantly first-generation agents.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) improve cardiometabolic outcomes, but their isolated effects on human bone remodeling remain uncertain because prior syntheses pooled heterogeneous study designs and active antidiabetic comparators. This systematic review and meta-analysis quantified the effects of GLP-1RAs versus placebo on densitometric, biochemical, and inflammatory markers of bone metabolism in randomized controlled trials (RCTs).
METHODS: Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, and PubMed/MEDLINE were searched from inception through May 12, 2026 for randomized placebo-controlled trials of GLP-1RAs or dual incretin agonists administered for 12 to 52 weeks. Eleven trials provided compatible data for random-effects meta-analysis and one additional trial was synthesized narratively, comprising 11 trials of first-generation agents (exenatide, dulaglutide, liraglutide) and one trial of second-generation semaglutide (1.0 mg/week), with zero eligible placebo-controlled trials identified for semaglutide 2.4 mg/week or tirzepatide. Weighted mean differences (WMDs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated for dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) bone mineral density (BMD), bone turnover markers, and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP), and evidence certainty was rated using GRADE.
RESULTS: Compared with placebo, GLP-1RA treatment reduced lumbar spine BMD (WMD: -0.02 g/cm2, 95% CI: -0.03 to -0.00, I2 = 0.0%; 3 trials, N = 222; Moderate certainty) and increased the bone resorption marker C-terminal telopeptide (CTX) (WMD: 0.05 μg/L, 95% CI: 0.01 to 0.08, I2 = 72.5%; 6 trials, N = 439; Low certainty), while reducing serum hs-CRP (WMD: -0.49 mg/L, 95% CI: -0.97 to -0.00, I2 = 0.0%; 4 trials [5 arms], N = 340; Low certainty). No significant differences were observed for femoral neck BMD (WMD: 0.01 g/cm2, 95% CI: -0.02 to 0.04, I2 = 68.9%; 5 trials [6 arms], N = 323; Very Low certainty), total hip BMD (WMD: 0.00 g/cm2, 95% CI: -0.02 to 0.03, I2 = 70.8%; 5 trials [6 arms], N = 382; Low certainty), or procollagen type 1 N-terminal propeptide (P1NP) (WMD: -1.24 μg/L, 95% CI: -3.61 to 1.13, I2 = 0.0%; 5 trials, N = 399; Moderate certainty), and leave-one-out exclusion of the single semaglutide trial did not alter the direction or significance of any pooled estimate.
CONCLUSIONS: Treatment with predominantly first-generation GLP-1RAs over 12 to 52 weeks increases osteoclastic bone resorption and induces a small, borderline reduction in lumbar spine BMD while preserving hip BMD and lowering systemic inflammation. Because existing placebo-controlled RCTs largely reflect earlier-generation agents with moderate weight loss, these findings cannot be extrapolated to higher-potency anti-obesity therapies such as semaglutide 2.4 mg/week or tirzepatide, which require dedicated long-term skeletal safety trials.
items.authors: Safargar Mohammad, Ahmadi Navid, Prabahar Kousalya, Zandi Reza, Varkaneh Hamed Kord
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）が骨代謝に及ぼす影響を、プラセボ対照無作為化試験（RCT）の系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシスにより定量化した研究。12〜52週間の投与期間を持つ、主に第1世代薬剤（エクセナチド、デュラグルチド、リラグルチド）および第2世代セマグルチド（1.0 mg/週）の11試験（メタアナリシス対象11試験＋叙述的統合1試験）を対象とし、DXAによる骨密度（BMD）、骨代謝マーカー、hs-CRPを評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 主に第1世代GLP-1RAの12〜52週間の投与は、破骨細胞由来の骨吸収（CTX上昇）を増加させ、腰椎BMDにわずかな境界的な低下を誘発する一方、股関節BMDは維持され、全身性炎症（hs-CRP）は低下した。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1RAは心代謝アウトカムを改善するが、骨リモデリングに対する単独効果は既往の異質な研究デザインや活性対照薬を含む統合により不確実であった。本研究はプラセボ対照RCTに限定して骨安全性の証拠を明確にし、さらにセマグルチド2.4 mg/週やtirzepatideのような高ポテンシーな抗肥満療法には外挿できないことを示し、専用の長期骨安全性試験の必要性を指摘している。

items.title: Efficacy and Safety of Dapagliflozin, Glimepiride, and Metformin Fixed-Dose Combination Tablet in Type 2 Diabetes: A Phase III Trial.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: The global burden of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is rapidly increasing, with India contributing significantly to the disease prevalence and associated economic burden. Despite metformin being the first-line therapy, many patients require combination treatment due to the progressive and multifactorial nature of T2DM. Fixed-dose combinations (FDCs) of drugs with complementary mechanisms may improve glycemic control, adherence, and treatment outcomes. This study has evaluated efficacy and safety of FDC of dapagliflozin (DAPA), glimepiride (GLIM), and metformin (MET) immediate release (IR) tablet versus co-administration of GLIM and MET tablets in patients with T2DM.
METHODS: This phase 3, randomized, open-label study included 536 Indian patients with T2DM [glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) ≥ 8.0% and ≤ 11%], randomized (1:1:1:1) into four arms in primary treatment period (up to Week 16): FDC of DAPA + GLIM + MET [5 mg+1 mg+500 mg (Test 1)] or [5 mg+1 mg+1000 mg (Test 2)] twice-daily, or co-administration of GLIM and MET (1 mg and 500 mg) (Comparator 1) or GLIM and MET (1 mg and 1000 mg) (Comparator 2) twice-daily. Patients with HbA1c ≥ 7.0% at week 16 entered an uptitration period (increased GLIM dose to 2 mg; Weeks 16-28). Change in HbA1c from baseline to Week 16 was the primary endpoint.
RESULTS: At Week 16, least-square mean HbA1c reduction was significantly greater with Test 1 (- 2.17%) versus Comparator 1 (- 1.64%, p = 0.0047) and Test 2 (- 2.25%) versus Comparator 2 (- 1.72%, p < 0.0001). Similarly, the proportion of patients achieving HbA1c < 7.0% at Week 16 was significantly greater in Test 1 versus Comparator 1 and Test 2 versus Comparator 2 (p < 0.0002 and p < 0.0001, respectively). Reduction in HbA1c, fasting, and postprandial blood glucose from baseline to Weeks 12, 16, and 28 was significant in all arms. Overall, treatments were well tolerated.
CONCLUSIONS: The FDC of DAPA + GLIM + MET IR tablet demonstrated superior glycemic control over co-administration of glimepiride and metformin and acceptable safety profile, making it an effective therapeutic option for T2DM management.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: Clinical Trials Registry India, CTRI/2022/06/043249.
items.authors: Kurmi Prakash, Singh Manish Kumar, Gupta Vishal, Siddegowda Chikkalingaiah, Shukla Jitendra, Gofne Sandip, Lomte Nilesh, Shendkar Kaustubh
items.summary_ja: 第III相、無作為化、オープンラベル試験として、インスリン抵抗性のある2型糖尿病患者536例（HbA1c ≥ 8.0%かつ≤ 11%）を対象に、ダパグリフロジン＋グリメピリド＋メトホルミンIR錠の固定用量配合（FDC）（Test 1: 5 mg+1 mg+500 mg、Test 2: 5 mg+1 mg+1000 mg、1日2回）とグリメピリド＋メトホルミンの併用（Comparator 1: 1 mg+500 mg、Comparator 2: 1 mg+1000 mg、1日2回）を比較した。主要評価項目はベースラインから16週までのHbA1c変化量であった。16週時点でHbA1c ≥ 7.0%の患者はグリメピリド増量（2 mg）による増量期間（16〜28週）に入った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ダパグリフロジン＋グリメピリド＋メトホルミンIR錠のFDCは、グリメピリド＋メトホルミンの併用と比較して血糖コントロールの優越性を示し、安全性も許容可能であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病の世界的な有病率増加に伴い、メトホルミン単剤では不十分な患者に併用療法が求められる。補完的機序を持つ薬剤の固定用量配合は、血糖コントロール、アドヒアランス、治療成績の改善に寄与する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 第III相、無作為化、オープンラベル、対照試験（優越性試験）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要評価項目：ベースラインから16週までのHbA1c変化量。副次評価項目：16週時点でHbA1c < 7.0%を達成した患者の割合、ベースラインから12週・16週・28週までのHbA1c・空腹時血糖・食後血糖の変化。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 16週時点の最小二乗平均HbA1c減少量：Test 1 −2.17% vs Comparator 1 −1.64%（p = 0.0047）、Test 2 −2.25% vs Comparator 2 −1.72%（p < 0.0001）。16週時点でHbA1c < 7.0%を達成した患者の割合：Test 1 vs Comparator 1（p < 0.0002）、Test 2 vs Comparator 2（p < 0.0001）で有意に高かった。全群でベースラインから12週・16週・28週までのHbA1c・空腹時血糖・食後血糖の減少が有意であった。

items.title: Tirzepatide-associated severe euvolemic hyponatremia with syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion-compatible biochemical features.
items.abstract: Tirzepatide is a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist that is being increasingly used for the management of type 2 diabetes mellitus and obesity. Gastrointestinal adverse effects associated with incretin-based therapies can influence water balance through nonosmotic vasopressin release and reduced oral solute intake. In this case report, we report a patient who developed severe symptomatic hyponatremia with biochemical features compatible with the syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion temporally associated with tirzepatide therapy. A woman with type 2 diabetes mellitus and morbid obesity on regular insulin and chronic torsemide therapy presented with anorexia, weakness, and drowsiness 10 days after tirzepatide administration. Serum sodium was 104 mmol/L, and she was clinically euvolemic. Renal, hepatic, hematologic, acid-base, and other endocrine parameters were normal. The calculated serum osmolality was 224 mOsm/kg. Urinary sodium remained elevated after withdrawal of the diuretic. The patient was managed with fluid restriction and hypertonic saline, and this resulted in progressive correction of sodium and clinical improvement. This case suggests a potential association between tirzepatide therapy and severe euvolemic hyponatremia. Clinicians should consider electrolyte monitoring in patients receiving incretin-based therapy who develop significant gastrointestinal symptoms or reduced oral intake.
items.authors: Prasad Nithin Tumkur
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病および肥満症の女性患者が、チルゼパチド投与10日後に食欲不振、脱力感、意識混濁を呈し、血清ナトリウム104 mmol/Lの重度の症状を伴う等容性低ナトリウム血症を発症した。臨床的に等容性であり、腎・肝・血液・酸塩基・内分泌パラメータは正常であった。計算血清浸透圧は224 mOsm/kg、利尿薬中止後も尿ナトリウムは高値を維持し、不適切な抗利尿ホルモン分泌症候群（SIADH）に一致する生化学的特徴を呈した。水分制限と高張食塩水による管理でナトリウムの漸進的修正と臨床的改善が得られた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: チルゼパチド治療と重度の等容性低ナトリウム血症（SIADHに一致する生化学的特徴を伴う）との関連が示唆された。インクリン系治療を受けており、著明な消化器症状や経口摂取減少を呈する患者では電解質モニタリングを検討すべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: チルゼパチドは2型糖尿病および肥満症の治療にますます使用されているが、インクリン系療法に伴う消化器系有害事象が非浸透圧性バソプレシン放出や経口溶質摂取の減少を介して水分バランスに影響を与える可能性があり、本症例は重度の低ナトリウム血症という重大な有害事象の可能性を臨床医に示している。
items.study_type_ja: 症例報告
items.endpoints_ja: チルゼパチド投与と時間的関連を有するSIADHに一致する生化学的特徴を伴う重度の等容性低ナトリウム血症の発症
items.endpoint_results_ja: 血清ナトリウム 104 mmol/L、計算血清浸透圧 224 mOsm/kg、利尿薬中止後も尿ナトリウムは高値を維持、水分制限と高張食塩水によりナトリウムの漸進的修正と臨床的改善

items.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Versus Empagliflozin or Dapagliflozin in the MASLD-Heart Failure Phenotype: An Exploratory Propensity-Matched Cohort Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Treatment selection may confound observational comparisons of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) and sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) in adults with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and heart failure (HF).
AIMS: To compare recorded outcomes between treatment groups and examine whether the associations persisted after restricting the analysis by agent and diabetes status and separating early and later outcome windows.
STUDY DESIGN: Retrospective, initiation-based, active-comparator cohort study (new-user design not verified).
METHODS: We used the TriNetX US Collaborative Network and a common index eligibility period from January 1, 2018, through June 2, 2026. The revised analyses were performed on September 12, 2026. An additional sensitivity analysis of acute HF excluded patients with this outcome before the start of the day 1-1825 window. The primary analysis compared semaglutide, liraglutide, or dulaglutide with empagliflozin or dapagliflozin using 1:1 propensity score matching and assessed outcomes during days 1-1825. Separate analyses of the broader GLP-1 RA group examined outcomes during days 1-90 and 91-1825 and among patients with type 2 diabetes and no recorded type 1 diabetes. We report endpoint-specific event proportions, risk differences, hazard ratios (HRs), 95% confidence intervals (CIs), and proportionality test results.
RESULTS: The primary analysis included 8,550 patients per group after matching. Mortality occurred in 599/8,514 (7.0%) versus 861/8,509 (10.1%); the HR was 0.607 (95% CI, 0.546-0.673). Coded acute HF diagnoses occurred in 1,217/8,550 (14.2%) versus 2,525/8,550 (29.5%); the HR was 0.398 (95% CI, 0.372-0.427), with evidence of non-proportional hazards. In separately matched descriptive interval analyses (8,489 patients per group), the HR for coded acute HF was 0.262 (95% CI, 0.236-0.291) during days 1-90 and 0.507 (95% CI, 0.469-0.548) during days 91-1825. The HR for acute kidney injury during the later interval was 0.740 (95% CI, 0.650-0.842). Among 5,709 matched pairs with type 2 diabetes and no recorded type 1 diabetes, the HR for coded acute HF was 0.431 (95% CI, 0.397-0.468), whereas the HR for ketoacidosis was 0.683 (95% CI, 0.455-1.025). No advantage was observed for acute pancreatitis in any analysis. In a separate analysis excluding patients with prior acute HF, the HR was 0.421 (95% CI, 0.362-0.489), with evidence of non-proportional hazards. Albumin and bilirubin remained imbalanced in a direction favoring the GLP-1 RA group; body mass index also remained imbalanced.
CONCLUSION: GLP-1 RA exposure was associated with lower observed hazards for several outcomes, and the association with coded acute HF was weaker after day 90. The early concentration and magnitude of this association make treatment channeling a plausible explanation, although this analysis cannot establish that explanation. These exploratory findings do not support causal inferences or treatment-preference conclusions and do not challenge randomized evidence supporting SGLT2i use in HF.
items.authors: Gautam Naveen, Huynh Tien Manh, Truong Hong Hieu, Duong Nikki
items.summary_ja: MASLD（代謝機能異常関連脂肪肝疾患）と心不全（HF）を併せ持つ成人において、GLP-1受容体作動薬（セマグルチド、リラグルチド、デュラグルチド）とSGLT2阻害薬（エンパグリフロジン、ダパグリフロジン）の記録されたアウトカムを比較する、後方視的・開始基準・活性比較コホート研究（探索的）。TriNetX US Collaborative Networkを用い、1:1プロパensityスコアマッチングにより8,550例/群を比較し、1〜1825日間のアウトカムを評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RA曝露は複数のアウトカムで低い観察ハザードと関連したが、急性HFとの関連は90日以降に弱まった。早期の集中と関連の大きさは治療チャネリング（treatment channeling）を妥当な説明として示唆するが、本分析ではその説明を確立できない。これらの探索的所見は因果推論や治療優先の結論を支持しない。
items.why_matters_ja: MASLD-HF表現型において、治療選択がGLP-1 RAとSGLT2iの観察的比較を交絡させる可能性がある。本結果は観察研究における治療チャネリングバイアスの重要性を示し、SGLT2iのHFにおける使用を支持するランダム化エビデンスには挑戦しない。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的・開始基準・活性比較コホート研究（探索的、1:1プロパensityスコアマッチング、new-user design未検証）

items.title: Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Death: a Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis Cardioprotective Efficacy of Semaglutide.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Cardiovascular death (CVD) remains a leading cause of global mortality. Although semaglutide reduces major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), the consistency and exact magnitude of its standalone effect on CVD across various patient phenotypes require comprehensive evaluation. This meta-analysis systematically evaluated the clinical efficacy of semaglutide on CVD risk across randomized controlled trials (RCTs).
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched up to July 2026 to identify RCTs comparing semaglutide with placebo in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), overweight or obesity, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) or chronic kidney disease, reporting CVD as a primary, secondary or exploratory outcome. Pooled hazard ratio (HR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) were calculated using a random-effects restricted maximum likelihood (REML) model. Publication bias and study robustness were assessed via Egger's test, Begg's test, and trim-and-fill analysis.
RESULTS: Seven high-quality RCTs comprising 38412 patients were included. Semaglutide significantly reduced the risk of CVD by 17% compared with placebo (pooled HR = 0.83, 95% CI: 0.72-0.95; P = 0.01). Inter-study heterogeneity was low-to-moderate (I 2= 27.44%, P = 0.18). Subgroup analyses confirmed uniform benefits across different clinical phenotypes (T2DM; overweight or obesity without diabetes; and obesity-related HFpEF, with or without T2DM; P = 0.63) and administration routes (oral versus subcutaneous; P = 0.74). Meta-regression identified trial duration as a key moderator (R 2 = 85.27%, P = 0.089), whereas sex, age, BMI, HbA1c and concomitant SGLT2i therapy did not modify the treatment effect. Publication bias tests were non-significant, and trim-and-fill simulations confirmed the stability of the primary pooled estimate.
CONCLUSION: Semaglutide delivers a robust and consistent 17% reduction in CVD across diverse cardiometabolic populations, including patients with T2DM, overweight or obesity without diabetes, and obesity-related HFpEF. These findings strongly support its role as a foundational cardioprotective intervention, independent of baseline glycemic status or the administration route.
items.authors: Marino Gaetano, Aquilani Stefano, Di Fusco Stefania Angela, Concistrè Antonio, Nardi Federico, Gabrielli Domenico, Imperoli Giuseppe, Colivicchi Furio
items.summary_ja: セマグルチドの心血管死（CVD）リスクに対する臨床的有効性を、無作為化比較試験（RCT）を横断して体系的に評価したメタ解析。PubMed、Embase、ClinicalTrials.govを2026年7月まで検索し、2型糖尿病（T2DM）、過体重または肥満、保存型心不全（HFpEF）、慢性腎臓病を有する成人において、セマグルチドとプラセボを比較しCVDを主要・副次・探索的アウトカムとして報告したRCTを抽出した。7件の高品質RCT（38,412例）が対象となり、ランダム効果REMLモデルによりプールハザード比（HR）と95%信頼区間（CI）を算出した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドは、T2DM、糖尿病を伴わない過体重または肥満、肥満関連HFpEFを含む多様な心代謝性集団において、CVDリスクを17%一貫して有意に低減した（プールHR = 0.83, 95% CI: 0.72-0.95; P = 0.01）。この効果はベースラインの血糖状態や投与経路（経口 vs 皮下）に依存しない。
items.why_matters_ja: 心血管死は依然として世界的な主要な死因であり、セマグルチドがMACEを低減することは知られているが、CVD単独への効果の一貫性と正確な大きさについては包括的評価が必要であった。本メタ解析は、セマグルチドが血糖状態や投与経路に依存しない基盤的な心保護介入として機能することを強く支持する。

items.endpoints_ja: 心血管死（CVD）（主要、副次、または探索的アウトカムとして報告されたもの）
items.endpoint_results_ja: プールHR = 0.83, 95% CI: 0.72-0.95; P = 0.01。研究間異質性：I² = 27.44%, P = 0.18。サブグループ解析（臨床表現型間）：P = 0.63。サブグループ解析（投与経路間）：P = 0.74。メタ回帰（試験期間）：R² = 85.27%, P = 0.089。

items.title: Changes in liver steatosis and liver stiffness following Empagliflozin treatment in patients with MASLD and type 2 diabetes: A single-arm pre-post study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is common in subjects with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), being linked to a higher risk for the development of liver-related and cardiovascular diseases. Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors such as empagliflozin have demonstrated possible hepatoprotective effects in previous research. The purpose of this study was to evaluate changes in liver enzymes, hepatic steatosis, and liver stiffness following 12 weeks of empagliflozin treatment in patients with T2DM and MASLD.
METHODS: In this nonrandomized, single-arm interventional study, 30 patients with T2DM and MASLD were treated simultaneously with empagliflozin 25 mg/day for 12 weeks in addition to the ongoing management. Liver function tests (ALT and AST), hepatic fat content (CAP score), and liver stiffness (LSM) were assessed at baseline and after 12 weeks treatment.
RESULTS: There were significant decreases in mean AST (80.27 ± 10.51 vs. 45.20 ± 3.20 U/L, P < 0.001) and ALT (86.33 ± 9.11 vs. 44.63 ± 3.62 U/L, P < 0.001) levels after treatment. The CAP score decreased from 321.83 ± 49.36 to 261.33 ± 35.14 (P < 0.001), and the LSM value decreased from 7.22 ± 1.04 to 6.24 ± 0.41 (P < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: In this single-arm pre-post study, 12 weeks of empagliflozin treatment was associated with significant reductions in liver enzyme levels, hepatic steatosis, and liver stiffness in patients with T2DM and MASLD. Larger controlled studies are required to determine whether these changes are attributable to empagliflozin and to assess their durability.
items.authors: Shieh Mobina, Dalil Davood, Arefzadeh Alireza, Shiehmorteza Maryam
items.summary_ja: T2DMを合併したMASLD患者30名を対象に、empagliflozin 25 mg/dayを12週間投与し、肝酵素（ALT・AST）、肝脂肪含量（CAP score）、肝硬度（LSM）をベースラインと12週後に評価した非ランダム化単一アーム介入試験。
items.key_takeaway_ja: T2DMを合併したMASLD患者において、12週間のempagliflozin投与は肝酵素値、肝脂肪症、肝硬度の有意な低下と関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: MASLDはT2DM患者に多く、肝関連疾患および心血管疾患のリスク上昇と関連する。SGLT2阻害薬の肝保護効果の解明は、MASLD治療戦略の選択肢を広げる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 非ランダム化単一アーム介入試験（pre-post study）
items.endpoints_ja: 肝機能検査（ALT・AST）、肝脂肪含量（CAP score）、肝硬度（LSM）

items.title: SGLT2 inhibitors in chronic kidney disease.
items.abstract: Sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) are a cornerstone therapy for kidney protection in individuals with both diabetic and nondiabetic kidney disease. Because many individuals with chronic kidney disease (CKD) are managed primarily or collaboratively by primary care providers, it is essential that these clinicians feel confident initiating and managing SGLT2i therapy to optimize kidney care. This review highlights landmark clinical trials demonstrating the renal benefits of SGLT2i and discusses practical considerations for their clinical use. It also explores emerging evidence supporting the potential role of SGLT2i therapy in patients with end-stage kidney disease receiving dialysis, kidney transplant recipients, autoimmune kidney diseases, autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease, electrolyte disorders, and nephrolithiasis.
items.authors: Yau Amy A, Bajaj Arrsh, Rizvi Ali, Li Jane, Kaur Tripta
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）は糖尿病性および非糖尿病性の腎疾患における腎保護の基幹治療である。本レビューは、SGLT2iの腎保護効果を示したランドマーク臨床試験を概観し、臨床使用上の実践的考慮事項を議論するとともに、透析中の末期腎不全患者、腎移植受者、自己免疫性腎疾患、常染色体優性多囊胞腎、電解質異常、腎結石症におけるSGLT2iの潜在的役割に関する新興エビデンスを考察している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2iは糖尿病性および非糖尿病性の腎疾患における腎保護の基幹治療であり、プライマリケア医がSGLT2i治療の開始と管理に自信を持てるよう支援することが腎ケアの最適化に不可欠である。
items.why_matters_ja: 慢性腎疾患（CKD）の多くはプライマリケア医が主たるまたは共同で管理しており、これらの臨床医がSGLT2i治療の開始と管理に自信を持てることは腎ケアの最適化に不可欠である。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Recent evidence for reducing cardiometabolic risk in chronic kidney disease.
items.abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and cardiovascular disease (CVD) frequently coexist, with an increasing risk of CVD as kidney function declines. Therefore, effective cardiovascular risk management is an essential part of the clinical care of patients with CKD. This article summarizes recent evidence of cardiovascular risk reduction in clinical trials of patients with CKD, focusing on sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), in addition to mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs). On the basis of current evidence, practice guidelines from 'Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO 2024)' recommend the use of SGLT2i for patients with estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) >20 mL/min/1.73 m2. The 2025 guidelines from the American Diabetes Association (ADA) also recommend SGLT2i for people with T2D and CKD (eGFR ≥20 mL/min/1.73 m2) to reduce the risk of CKD progression and cardiovascular events. At present, finerenone is the only nonsteroidal MRA with evidence of cardiovascular and renal benefits in patients with CKD and T2D, and the use of this agent is recommended for patients with T2D at high risk of CKD progression and cardiovascular events. Cardiorenal protective effects have been observed with GLP-1 RAs. The ADA recommends a GLP-1 RA with demonstrated benefit in reducing cardiovascular risk and kidney disease progression for patients with CKD and T2D. A combination of SGLT2i, GLP-1 RAs, and nonsteroidal MRA may be considered for management of patients with CKD and T2D. Overall, a holistic, multidisciplinary approach to the care of people with CKD is recommended. This may involve multiple disease specialists, including cardiologists, nephrologists, endocrinologists, primary care physicians, and other healthcare professionals in the medical team. Clinicians have a key role in ensuring the implementation of evidence-based therapies for patients with CKD, with the ultimate aim of slowing progression of CKD, reducing metabolic complications, and improving cardiovascular outcomes.
items.authors: Arora Nayan, Ryan Eric
items.summary_ja: 慢性腎臓病（CKD）と心血管疾患（CVD）は頻繁に併存し、腎機能の低下に伴いCVDリスクが増加する。本レビューは、CKD患者における心血管リスク低減に関する最近の臨床試験のエビデンスを総括し、SGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）、鉱質コルチコイド受容体拮抗薬（MRA）、グルカゴン様ペプチド-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）に焦点を当てている。KDIGO 2024ガイドラインはeGFR>20 mL/min/1.73m²のCKD患者へのSGLT2i使用を推奨し、ADA 2025ガイドラインもT2D合併CKD（eGFR≥20）患者へのSGLT2i使用を推奨している。フィネレノンはCKD合併T2D患者で心血管・腎保護効果のエビデンスを持つ唯一の非ステロイド性MRAであり、GLP-1 RAにも心腎保護効果が認められている。SGLT2i、GLP-1 RA、非ステロイド性MRAの併用がCKD合併T2D患者の管理に考慮され得るとされている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CKD合併T2D患者において、SGLT2i、非ステロイド性MRA（フィネレノン）、GLP-1 RAのいずれも心腎保護効果のエビデンスがあり、これらを組み合わせた多面的なアプローチが推奨される。
items.why_matters_ja: CKDとCVDは頻繁に併存し、腎機能の低下に伴いCVDリスクが増加するため、CKD患者の臨床管理において効果的な心血管リスク管理が不可欠である。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（総説）
items.endpoints_ja: 心血管イベント、CKDの進行、心血管アウトカム

items.title: Dapagliflozin attenuates progression from prefrailty to frailty in patients with hypertension and chronic kidney disease.
items.abstract: BACKGROUNDChronic kidney disease (CKD) and hypertension share common pathophysiological pathways contributing to vascular damage, endothelial dysfunction, and physical decline, particularly in older adults with prefrailty. To evaluate the relationship among renal injury, physical performance, and frailty progression in hypertensive older adults with CKD and assess whether dapagliflozin associates with reduced frailty progression, we designed the study DAPA-FORTRESS (DAPAgliflozin and Frailty prOgression in hypeRTension and chRonic kidnEy diSeaSe).METHODSWe enrolled 135 prefrail hypertensive patients with CKD aged >65 years and followed them for 1 year. After coarsened exact matching, our balanced cohort had 105 patients (52 dapagliflozin). Associations between albuminuria, estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), and physical performance were analyzed using correlation and regression models. Effect of dapagliflozin on frailty progression was evaluated using multivariable logistic regression.RESULTSA significant inverse association between gait speed and albuminuria (r2 = 0.48, P < 0.0001) and significant positive linear association between gait speed and eGFR (r2 = 0.18; P < 0.0001) were observed. Patients with eGFR <60 mL/min/1.73 m2 exhibited significantly worse physical performance than those with higher eGFR (P = 0.0003). In adjusted analyses, receiving dapagliflozin was independently associated with lower odds of progressing to frailty at 1 year (OR = 0.130; CI 0.045-0.381; P < 0.001).CONCLUSIONIn older hypertensive patients with CKD, greater renal injury is associated with worse physical performance, while dapagliflozin use reduces the risk of frailty progression. These findings indicate a potential protective role of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibition in mitigating functional decline in this high-risk population.FUNDINGNIH: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (R01-HL146691), National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (R01-DK123259); American Heart Association (AHA- 24IPA1268813, AHA-22-915561, AHA-24-1195524).
items.authors: Mone Pasquale, Viggiano Davide, Pansini Antonella, Soldovieri Maria Virginia, Sabatelli Giada, Visco Valeria, Macina Gaetano, Boccalone Eugenio
items.summary_ja: DAPA-FORTRESS研究は、65歳以上の前虚弱（prefrailty）を有する高血圧性慢性腎臓病（CKD）患者135名を1年間追跡した前向きコホート研究である。粗い完全マッチング（coarsened exact matching）後、均衡化コホートは105名（ダパグリフロジン群52名）となった。腎障害（アルブミン尿、eGFR）と身体機能（歩行速度）の関連、およびダパグリフロジン使用と虚弱化進行の関連を相関・回帰モデルおよび多変量ロジスティック回帰で解析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 高血圧性CKDを有する高齢前虚弱患者において、腎障害の程度が大きいほど身体機能（歩行速度）は低下しており、ダパグリフロジンの使用は1年後の虚弱化進行のオッズを有意に低減した（OR = 0.130; 95% CI 0.045-0.381; P < 0.001）。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬が、高血圧・CKDを合併する高齢前虚弱患者という高リスク集団において、機能低下（虚弱化進行）を軽減する保護的役割を持つ可能性を示唆しており、CKD患者の身体機能維持におけるSGLT2阻害薬の新たな適応可能性を提示する。
items.study_type_ja: 前向きコホート研究（観察研究）。粗い完全マッチングを用いたダパグリフロジン使用者と非使用者の比較。
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：1年後の虚弱化進行（前虚弱から虚弱への移行）。探索的解析：歩行速度とアルブミン尿の関連、歩行速度とeGFRの関連、eGFR <60 mL/min/1.73 m²群とそれ以外群の身体機能比較。
items.sample_size_ja: 登録135名（65歳以上の前虚弱を有する高血圧性CKD患者）。粗い完全マッチング後、解析対象105名（ダパグリフロジン群52名）。

items.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Effects on Food-Related Cognition: A Cognitive Neuroscience Framework.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have transformed the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity by reducing appetite, cravings and caloric intake. Growing evidence suggests effects on the central nervous system, with cognitive and neuroprotective benefits that cannot be explained by weight loss or glycaemic control alone. However, the underlying neurocognitive mechanisms remain unclear. This review proposes a cognitive neuroscience framework for investigating the effects of GLP-1RAs across multiple levels of food-related information processing. Theoretical models and experimental paradigms are integrated to dissociate perceptual, attentional, motivational, semantic and executive components. The model identifies four levels: (1) early perceptual processing, in which the brain extracts properties including caloric content and transformation; (2) attentional capture and motivational salience, which determine priorities and wanting; (3) semantic organisation, which integrates sensory and functional characteristics of foods and (4) decision-making and executive control, including inhibitory control and effort allocation. GLP-1RAs may differentially modulate these levels, which can be investigated using specific experimental paradigms. This cognitive neuroscience-based approach goes beyond descriptive measures to identify the mechanisms through which GLP-1RAs influence perception, motivation and food decisions. This framework can guide future studies, improve the interpretation of cognitive effects and contribute to the development of more targeted interventions.
items.journal: The Neuroscientist : a review journal bringing neurobiology, neurology and psychiatry
items.authors: Pisanu Elisabetta, Coricelli Carol, Lucia Stefania, Terenzi Damiano, Aiello Marilena, Centonze Diego, Federici Massimo, Rumiati Raffaella I
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）が食物関連認知に及ぼす影響を、認知神経科学の枠組みから検討したレビューである。食物関連情報処理の複数のレベル（(1)初期知覚処理、(2)注意捕捉と動機づけ的顕著性、(3)意味的組織化、(4)意思決定と実行機能制御）を特定し、各レベルを分離するための理論モデルと実験パラダイムを統合した枠組みを提案している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RAは食物関連情報処理の各レベル（知覚、注意、動機づけ、意味処理、実行機能）を差別的に調節する可能性があり、認知神経科学に基づく枠組みを用いることで、GLP-1RAが知覚・動機づけ・食物決定に影響を与えるメカニズムを特定できる。
items.why_matters_ja: 記述的な測定を超えてGLP-1RAの認知効果のメカニズムを特定し、将来の研究を導き、認知効果の解釈を改善し、よりターゲットを絞った介入の開発に貢献できる。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（理論的・概念的枠組みの提案）
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: SGLT2 inhibitor-induced genitourinary infections and the consequent antimicrobial-antidiabetic drug interactions: A narrative review of clinical and pharmacovigilance concern.
items.abstract: Sodium glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors provide cardiovascular and renal benefits in type 2 diabetes mellitus, chronic kidney disease, and heart failure, but their use is associated with genitourinary (GU) infections and medication-safety concerns during antimicrobial treatment. This narrative review integrate evidence regarding SGLT2 inhibitor-associated GU infections, antimicrobial-antidiabetic drug interactions, pharmacovigilance, clinical management, and antimicrobial stewardship. Evidence from randomized controlled trials, meta-analysis, observational studies, pharmacokinetic studies and pharmacovigilance databases were used to synthesise on infection risk, drug interactions, management and safety issues in vulnerable populations. To identify relevant evidence narrative review was completed with evidence found in Pubmed, Google scholar, Clinical trial gov between 2020 and 2026. A purposive selection of literature was conducted to identify studies relevant to the article with a methodological strength, and not a systematic search was used.SGLT2 inhibitors demonstrate a more consistent association with genital mycotic infections than urinary tract infections (UTIs). Most GU infections are mild to moderate and can be treated with standard antimicrobial or antifungal therapy without routine discontinuation of SGLT2 inhibitors. SGLT2 inhibitors have low potential for drug-drug interactions, however, exposure to other agents can altered by strong enzyme inducers like rifampin, and this effect varies by SGLT2 inhibitor. Pharmacovigilance complements trial evidence by identifying safety signals, although disproportionality signals require clinical validation. Antimicrobial stewardship also enables treatment, avoidance of unnecessary prophylaxis, evaluation of risk factors, and assessment of concomitant medications and interactions.
items.authors: Chandel Piyush, Sharma Akanksha, Vijukumar Abhishek, Kosey Sourabh, Haneef Mohd
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は2型糖尿病、慢性腎臓病、心不全において心血管・腎保護効果を示すが、泌尿器科（GU）感染症との関連が指摘されている。本叙述的レビューは、SGLT2阻害薬関連のGU感染症、抗菌薬・抗糖尿病薬間の薬物相互作用、薬物警戒、臨床管理、抗菌薬適正使用に関する証拠を統合した。2020年から2026年までのPubMed、Google Scholar、ClinicalTrials.govから証拠を収集し、無作為化比較試験、メタアナリシス、観察研究、薬物動態研究、薬物警戒データベースの証拠を統合した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は尿路感染症よりも外陰部真菌症との関連が一貫して強く示されているが、大多数のGU感染症は軽〜中等度であり、SGLT2阻害薬の常規的な中止なしに標準的な抗菌・抗真菌治療で対応可能である。SGLT2阻害薬の薬物相互作用の潜在性は低いものの、リファムピンなどの強力な酵素誘導体による曝露変化がSGLT2阻害薬の種類によって異なる。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の心血管・腎保護効果により使用が拡大する中、GU感染症のリスク管理と抗菌薬治療時の薬物相互作用の理解は、特に脆弱な患者集団における安全性確保と抗菌薬適正使用の観点から臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的レビュー（Narrative Review）
items.endpoints_ja: SGLT2阻害薬関連のGU感染症（外陰部真菌症、尿路感染症）のリスク、抗菌薬・抗糖尿病薬間の薬物相互作用、薬物警戒シグナル、臨床管理、抗菌薬適正使用

items.title: Association of GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy with cardiovascular outcomes in patients with MASLD: A translational study.
items.abstract: Patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and type 2 diabetes (T2D) are at increased risk of adverse cardiovascular outcomes, potentially involving systemic metabolic dysfunction and cardiac remodeling. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) improve metabolic dysfunction in MASLD; however, their associations with cardiovascular outcomes and effects on MASLD-associated cardiac remodeling remain incompletely understood. In this translational study, we integrated a real-world TriNetX cohort of patients with MASLD and T2D with complementary experimental studies in a mouse model of MASLD. Following propensity score matching, 42,910 patients were included in each treatment group. GLP-1 RA therapy was associated with a lower risk of the primary composite cardiovascular outcome compared with sulfonylurea therapy (hazard ratio 0.87, 95% confidence interval 0.84-0.91; P < 0.001), although this association was not statistically significant in 90-day and 180-day landmark analyses. In Western diet-fed mice, GLP-1 RA treatment improved selected indices of cardiac function and attenuated cardiomyocyte hypertrophy. Although myocardial fibrosis was numerically reduced, the difference compared with vehicle-treated mice was not statistically significant (P = 0.28). Molecular analyses showed reduced expression of fibrosis- and extracellular matrix remodeling-related markers, including CTGF, TGF-β1, and vimentin. Collectively, GLP-1 RA therapy was associated with lower cardiovascular risk in the primary observational analysis, although this finding was not consistently supported by sensitivity analyses. Complementary experimental findings suggest improvements in selected cardiac functional indices and changes in fibrosis-associated molecular remodeling, warranting further investigation.
items.authors: Yang Chun-Chi, Wu Jheng-Yan, Ko Yu-Min, Wang Shu-Chi, Cheng Ya-Yun, Yu Ming-Lung, Chang Wei-Ting
items.summary_ja: MASLDと2型糖尿病を併せ持つ患者の心血管転帰とGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）の関連を解明するため、TriNetX実世界コホート（MASLD＋T2D患者）とMASLDマウスモデルの実験研究を統合したトランスレーショナル研究である。傾向スコアマッチング後、各治療群に42,910例が組み込まれた。GLP-1 RA療法はスルホニルウレア療法と比較して主要複合心血管転帰のリスクが低かった（ハザード比0.87、95%信頼区間0.84-0.91；P＜0.001）が、90日・180日のランドマーク解析では統計的に有意ではなかった。Western diet投与マウスでは、GLP-1 RA治療が心機能の一部指標を改善し、心筋細胞肥大を軽減した。心筋線維化は数値上減少したが、vehicle群との差は統計的に有意ではなかった（P＝0.28）。分子解析では、CTGF、TGF-β1、vimentinなどの線維化・細胞外マトリックスリモデリング関連マーカーの発現が低下した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RA療法は主要観察解析において心血管リスクの低下と関連したが、感度解析（ランドマーク解析）では一貫して支持されなかった。補完的な実験研究では心機能指標の改善と線維化関連分子リモデリングの変化が示唆され、さらなる調査が必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: MASLDと2型糖尿病を併せ持つ患者は全身性代謝異常と心リモデリングを介して心血管不良転帰のリスクが高い。GLP-1 RAがこの集団における心血管転帰に与える影響とMASLD関連心リモデリングへの効果は未解明であり、本研究は臨床的治療判断の根拠となる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: トランスレーショナル研究（実世界コホート研究＋マウスモデルによる実験研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：複合心血管転帰。二次・探索的エンドポイント：心機能指標、心筋細胞肥大、心筋線維化、線維化・細胞外マトリックスリモデリング関連分子マーカー（CTGF、TGF-β1、vimentin）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要複合心血管転帰：ハザード比0.87、95%信頼区間0.84-0.91；P＜0.001（スルホニルウレア療法と比較）。90日・180日ランドマーク解析：統計的に有意差なし。心筋線維化：P＝0.28（vehicle群と比較、統計的に有意差なし）。CTGF、TGF-β1、vimentin：発現低下（具体的数値は抄録に記載なし）

items.title: Empagliflozin's role in cardiometabolic disease treatment: an Egyptian expert's view.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Given the expanding therapeutic indications of empagliflozin (EMPA) beyond glycemic control and the growing burden of cardiometabolic diseases, this review evaluated its efficacy, safety, and cost-effectiveness in the Egyptian population within the global context.
METHODS: A comprehensive literature review of PubMed and Google Scholar identified clinical trials, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and clinical guidelines published in English up to July 2025. We included studies reporting EMPA's pharmacological profile, mechanisms of action, and clinical outcomes on diabetes mellitus, cardiometabolic diseases, renal and hepatic functions, safety during Ramadan fasting, and cost-effectiveness.
RESULTS: EMPA, as monotherapy or combination therapy, improves glycemic control in type 2 diabetes through Sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 (SGLT-2) inhibition. For type 1 diabetes mellitus, despite improving glycemic control as an adjunct therapy, it is not recommended due to the increased risk of diabetic ketoacidosis. EMPA reduces major cardiovascular events, heart failure hospitalization, and chronic kidney disease progression, with modest weight loss and blood pressure reduction, in patients with or without diabetes. Emerging evidence suggests benefits in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), although it is not approved for this indication. EMPA demonstrates a favorable safety profile and low hypoglycemia risk during Ramadan fasting. It enhances patients' quality of life and is considered cost-effective.
CONCLUSIONS: EMPA extends beyond glucose-lowering by reducing cardiorenal morbidity and mortality in patients with or without diabetes. It shows a favorable safety profile, even during Ramadan fasting, supporting its suitability for the large Muslim population. Further research should evaluate its role in MASLD and assess cost-effectiveness in Egypt.
items.authors: Assaad-Khalil Samir H, Elmessallamy Fawzy, Elhadidy Khaled Elsayed, El Hefnawy Mohamed Hesham, Halawa Mohamed Reda, Zeitoun Mohamed, Hussein Shady, Elebrashy Ibrahim
items.summary_ja: エムパグリフロジン（EMPA）の血糖管理以外の治療適応が拡大し、心代謝疾患の負担が増大する中、本レビューはエジプト人口におけるEMPAの有効性、安全性、費用対効果をグローバルな文脈で評価した。PubMedおよびGoogle Scholarから2025年7月までに英語で出版された臨床試験、系統的レビュー、メタアナリシス、臨床ガイドラインを包括的に検索し、糖尿病、心代謝疾患、腎・肝機能、ラマダン断食中の安全性、費用対効果に関する臨床アウトカムを網羅的に検討した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: EMPAは降血糖作用を超え、糖尿病の有無を問わず心腎臓の有病率および死亡率を低下させる。ラマダン断食中においても良好な安全性プロファイルを示し、大規模なムスリム人口への適用を支持する。
items.why_matters_ja: 心代謝疾患の負担が増大し、EMPAの適応が血糖管理以外に拡大する中、エジプトという特定の地域・文化的文脈（特にラマダン断食）における有用性を評価した点に意義がある。MASLDへの効果やエジプトにおける費用対効果のさらなる評価が今後の課題として示されている。
items.study_type_ja: 包括的文献レビュー（comprehensive literature review）
items.endpoints_ja: 血糖コントロール、主要心血管イベント、心不全入院、慢性腎臓病の進行、体重減少、血圧低下、ラマダン断食中の安全性（低血糖リスク）、生活の質（QOL）、費用対効果

items.title: Activities of daily living and health status benefits of semaglutide in very old patients with heart failure, type 2 diabetes, and obesity: Real-world practice study.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION AND OBJECTIVES: The role of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in patients with heart failure has not been widely described. We aimed to analyze the efficacy of once-weekly semaglutide in very old patients with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and heart failure in terms of activities of daily living performance and health status.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: This real-world observational study included patients ≥80 years with heart failure, diabetes, and obesity treated with semaglutide (Sema-Old Group) and patients not treated with glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists (Control-Old Group). The co-primary outcomes were improvement in activities of daily living performance (measured using the Barthel Index) and health status (measured using the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire) at 24 months.
RESULTS: After propensity score matching, 232 patients were included in each group. The use of once-weekly semaglutide was associated with greater improvement in activities of daily living performance and health status in the Sema-Old Group compared to the Control-Old Group (Odds Ratio: 4.03; 95% Confidence Interval: 1.82-7.31; p<.01; Odds Ratio: 4.65; 95% Confidence Interval: 1.92-7.71; p<.01; respectively). There were also reductions in heart failure and all-cause hospitalizations, and cardiovascular death. Semaglutide use was associated with improved glycemic control and reduced body weight. Negative correlations were observed between activities of daily living performance and heart failure health status with the body weight and NT-proBNP levels.
CONCLUSIONS: Once-weekly semaglutide use was associated with improvements in activities of daily living performance and heart failure health status in very old patients with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and heart failure.

items.summary_ja: 80歳以上の心不全・2型糖尿病・肥満を有する高齢患者において、週1回セマグルチドの日常生活動作（ADL）遂行能力および健康状態への影響を、実世界観察研究として検討した。プロパティスコアマッチングによりセマグルチド群（Sema-Old Group）とGLP-1受容体作動薬未使用群（Control-Old Group）を比較し、24か月時点のADL遂行能力（Barthel Index）および健康状態（Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire）を共同主要評価項目として評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 80歳以上の心不全・2型糖尿病・肥満患者において、週1回セマグルチドの使用は、GLP-1受容体作動薬未使用群と比較してADL遂行能力および心不全の健康状態の改善と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬が心不全患者において果たす役割は十分に報告されておらず、特に80歳以上の超高齢患者における実世界での有効性データは限られている。本研究は、この脆弱な集団におけるセマグルチドのADLおよび健康状態への有益性を示す実世界エビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 実世界観察研究（プロパティスコアマッチング適用）
items.endpoints_ja: 共同主要評価項目：24か月時点のADL遂行能力（Barthel Index）および健康状態（Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire）の改善。その他：心不全入院、全原因入院、心血管死亡、血糖コントロール、体重。
items.endpoint_results_ja: ADL遂行能力の改善：Odds Ratio 4.03（95% CI 1.82-7.31、p<.01）。健康状態の改善：Odds Ratio 4.65（95% CI 1.92-7.71、p<.01）。心不全入院・全原因入院・心血管死亡の減少が認められたが、具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし。血糖コントロールの改善および体重減少が認められたが、具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし。

items.title: The metabolic-brain axis: GLP-1 signaling, insulin resistance, and obesity pharmacotherapy in neurodegeneration.
items.abstract: The intersection of metabolic disease and neurodegeneration represents one of the most consequential frontiers in translational neuroscience. Converging epidemiological, mechanistic, and pharmacological evidence supports a bidirectional metabolic-brain axis in which systemic insulin resistance, obesity, and chronic metabolic inflammation are associated with and may contribute to alterations in neuronal survival, synaptic plasticity, and neuroimmune homeostasis. GLP-1 receptor agonists, originally developed for glycemic control and weight management, have therefore been investigated as potential disease-modifying therapies across Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and related neurodegenerative conditions through mechanisms including neuronal PKA activation, microglial NLRP3 suppression, mitochondrial biogenesis, and restoration of AQP4 perivascular localization that may contribute to glymphatic waste clearance. Direct human evidence for these CNS mechanisms remains limited or absent, with current support derived primarily from preclinical models and indirect human data, as detailed in Table 1, warranting dedicated investigation in the context of GLP-1 receptor agonism. Importantly, the two pivotal phase 3 programs designed to test this hypothesis in humans - EVOKE/EVOKE+ in early Alzheimer's disease and Exenatide-PD3 in Parkinson's disease - have both now reported, and neither demonstrated a statistically significant benefit on its primary clinical endpoint, despite favorable biomarker and epidemiological signals preceding these results. This review synthesizes current knowledge on brain insulin signaling, GLP-1 neurobiology, obesity-driven neuroinflammation, and the translational evidence for metabolic therapeutics in neurodegeneration, and uses the dissociation between mechanistic plausibility, epidemiological association, and null confirmatory trial results to identify critical knowledge gaps and translational barriers related to CNS target engagement, optimal dosing, and disease-modifying efficacy of GLP-1 receptor agonists. The review is organized into four major themes: brain insulin signaling, central GLP-1 biology, obesity-associated neuroinflammation, and the translational evidence supporting metabolic therapies for neurodegenerative disease.
items.authors: Santerre Maryline, Shcherbik Natalia, Sawaya Bassel E
items.summary_ja: 代謝性疾患と神経変性の交差に関する総説。全身性インスリン抵抗性、肥満、慢性代謝性炎症が神経細胞生存、シナプス可塑性、神経免疫恒常性に影響を与える双方向性の代謝-脳軸について、疫学的・機能的・薬理学的証拠を統合した。GLP-1受容体作動薬がアルツハイマー病、パーキンソン病などの神経変性疾患に対する疾患修飾療法として検討されてきたが、2つの主要な第III相試験（EVOKE/EVOKE+：早期アルツハイマー病、Exenatide-PD3：パーキンソン病）はいずれも主要臨床エンドポイントにおいて統計的に有意な有益性を示さなかった。機能的妥当性、疫学的関連、陰性の確認試験結果の乖離から、CNSターゲットエンゲージメント、最適用量、疾患修飾効果に関する重要な知識ギャップと翻訳的障壁を特定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬は前臨床モデルと疫学的シグナルで有望とされたが、2つの主要な第III相試験（EVOKE/EVOKE+、Exenatide-PD3）はいずれも主要臨床エンドポイントで統計的に有意な有益性を示さず、機能的妥当性と臨床的有効性の間に乖離があることが示された。
items.why_matters_ja: 前臨床・疫学的証拠と確認試験の陰性結果の乖離を明らかにすることで、GLP-1受容体作動薬の神経変性疾患への応用におけるCNSターゲットエンゲージメント、最適用量、疾患修飾効果に関する翻訳的障壁の特定に寄与し、今後の臨床開発戦略の方向性を示唆する。

items.title: Efficacy and safety of oral orforglipron in Japanese participants with obesity disease (ATTAIN-J): a double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, phase 3 trial.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Orforglipron, a small-molecule, non-peptide, oral GLP-1 receptor agonist, has shown bodyweight reduction and cardiometabolic benefits in adults with obesity across phase 3 trials globally. We aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of orforglipron versus placebo for treating obesity disease in Japanese adults.
METHODS: ATTAIN-J was a double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, phase 3 trial conducted across 16 medical research centres and hospitals in Japan and included adults aged 18 years or older with a BMI between 27 kg/m2 and less than 35 kg/m2 and two or more obesity-related health disorders, or a BMI of 35 kg/m2 or higher and one or more obesity-related health disorder, with one or more of the obesity-related health disorders being hypertension, dyslipidaemia, or type 2 diabetes (targeted at about 25% of participants), consistent with Japanese indications for tirzepatide and semaglutide for obesity disease; and at least one unsuccessful dietary attempt to lose weight. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1:1:1) via a computer-generated sequence to once-daily oral orforglipron (6 mg, 12 mg, or 36 mg) or placebo. Co-primary endpoints were mean percentage change in bodyweight and percentage of participants with at least 5% bodyweight reduction from baseline to week 72. Efficacy endpoints were primarily evaluated by the treatment regimen estimand in all randomly assigned participants. Safety was assessed in participants who received at least one dose of study treatment. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05931380 (completed).
FINDINGS: Between July 31, 2023, and June 19, 2025, 291 participants were screened, of whom 238 (144 [61%] males and 94 [39%] females; mean age 54·1 years [SD 11·2]) were randomly assigned to receive orforglipron 6 mg (n=61), 12 mg (n=57), or 36 mg (n=60), or placebo (n=60); 214 (90%) participants completed the study. At week 72, mean percentage change in bodyweight was -5·9% (95% CI -7·6 to -4·2) with orforglipron 6 mg, -8·7% (-10·9 to -6·5) with 12 mg, and -7·9% (-10·0 to -5·8) with 36 mg, compared with -0·6% (-2·1 to 0·8) with placebo (all p<0·0001 vs placebo). At week 72, a bodyweight reduction of at least 5% was seen in 15·2% (SE 4·8; nine of 60) of participants in the placebo group compared with 45·6% (6·1; 28 of 61; p=0·0001) of participants in the orforglipron 6 mg group, 60·8% (6·4; 35 of 57; p<0·0001) of participants in the orforglipron 12 mg group, and 58·8% (6·5; 35 of 60; p<0·0001) of participants in the orforglipron 36 mg group. Adverse events with orforglipron were mostly mild-to-moderate gastrointestinal symptoms. Across all orforglipron groups, treatment-emergent adverse events that most frequently led to study treatment discontinuation were nausea (one [2%] of 61 in the 6 mg group, one [2%] of 57 in the 12 mg group, and five [8%] of 60 in the 36 mg group vs none with placebo) and vomiting (none in the 6 mg group, two [4%] in the 12 mg group, and one [2%] in the 36 mg group vs none in the placebo group).
INTERPRETATION: In Japanese adults with obesity disease, once-daily orforglipron resulted in statistically superior reductions in bodyweight versus placebo, with a safety profile consistent with that of other GLP-1 receptor agonists.
FUNDING: Eli Lilly and Company.
TRANSLATION: For the Japanese translation of the abstract see Supplementary Materials section.
items.authors: Yokote Koutaro, Yamauchi Toshimasa, Shingaki Tomotaka, Chin Rina, Oura Tomonori, Nagai Yukiko, Shimomura Iichiro, Kadowaki Takashi
items.summary_ja: ATTAIN-Jは、日本の肥満症患者における経口orforglipron（小分子・非ペプチド型GLP-1受容体作動薬）の有効性と安全性をプラセボ対照で評価した第III相二重盲検ランダム化並行群間試験である。日本国内16施設で238例がランダム化され（orforglipron 6 mg: n=61、12 mg: n=57、36 mg: n=60、プラセボ: n=60）、72週時点でorforglipron全用量群でプラセボ統計的に優越した体重減少が示された。有害事象は主に軽〜中等度の消化器症状であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 日本の肥満症患者において、1日1回の経口orforglipronはプラセボと比較して統計的に優越した体重減少を示し、安全性プロファイルは他のGLP-1受容体作動薬と一致した。
items.why_matters_ja: 経口型の非ペプチドGLP-1受容体作動薬として、日本における肥満症治療の新たな選択肢を提供する可能性がある。全球の第III相試験で体重減少および心代謝上の利益が示されてきたorforglipronの日本人群での有効性を確認した。
items.study_type_ja: 二重盲検、ランダム化、プラセボ対照、並行群間、第III相試験
items.endpoints_ja: 共同一次エンドポイント：(1) 体重の平均変化率（ベースラインから72週）、(2) 体重減少が5%以上の被験者の割合（ベースラインから72週）。有効性は治療レジメンestimandにより全ランダム化被験者で評価。安全性は試験治療を少なくとも1回受けた被験者で評価。

items.title: Urinary tract and genital infections with dapagliflozin and empagliflozin across type 2 diabetes, heart failure, and chronic kidney disease: An indication- and sex-stratified disproportionality analysis of eudravigilance reports.
items.abstract: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are widely used in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), chronic heart failure (CHF), and chronic kidney disease (CKD). Although their cardiovascular and renal benefits are well established, urogenital infections remain a relevant safety concern. Comparative post-marketing data on dapagliflozin (DAPA) and empagliflozin (EMPA) across therapeutic indications are limited. A retrospective pharmacovigilance analysis of the EudraVigilance database (January 2021-July 2025) was conducted using a case/non-case approach. Cases were defined as individual case safety reports (ICSRs) containing at least one urogenital infection-coded reaction and a confirmed indication (T2DM, CHF, or CKD). The primary analysis was restricted to reports originating from the European Economic Area (EEA), where reporting rules are identical for both drugs; reports with unspecified patient age were excluded. Among 16,102 EEA ICSRs, 8156 adult reports with a confirmed indication were analyzed, of which 1109 met the case definition. Non-EEA reports were analyzed separately as a sensitivity analysis. Urogenital infection reporting did not differ between DAPA and EMPA, overall (ROR 0.91; 95% CI 0.80-1.03) or within any indication (T2DM: 13.9% vs 14.9%, ROR 0.92; 95% CI 0.79-1.07; CHF: 11.5% vs 12.6%, ROR 0.90; 95% CI 0.69-1.18; CKD: 11.0% vs 6.7%, ROR 1.73; 95% CI 0.75-3.99). For both drugs, reporting was higher in T2DM than in CHF (DAPA ROR 1.25; 95% CI 1.00-1.56; EMPA ROR 1.22; 95% CI 0.99-1.51), a difference confined to female patients (DAPA 1.38; EMPA 1.56) and, in the endpoint disaggregation, to genital mycotic infections (DAPA 2.24; EMPA 1.79) rather than non-mycotic urogenital infections. Female sex was the strongest determinant of urogenital infection reporting for both drugs (ROR female/male 1.85 for DAPA and 1.58 for EMPA). In non-EEA reports, an apparent excess of urogenital infection reporting with DAPA over EMPA (ROR 1.85; 95% CI 1.59-2.16) was explained by a different composition of the reports forwarded for the two drugs rather than by a drug effect. Urogenital infection reporting with SGLT2 inhibitors depends on indication and sex rather than on the molecule, and between-drug comparisons in EudraVigilance are sensitive to the geographic origin of reports.
items.authors: Graziosi Agnese, Riemma Maria Antonietta, Gurgone Danila, Schianchi Alice, Morroni Fabiana, Sita Giulia, Baratta Francesco, Veronese Chiara
items.summary_ja: EudraVigilanceデータベース（2021年1月〜2025年7月）を用いた後方視的薬物警戒分析であり、case/non-caseアプローチによる不均衡分析で、DAPAとEMPAの泌尿生殖器感染症報告をT2DM・CHF・CKDの適応別および性別に層別比較した。EEA由来のICSR 16,102件中、適応が確認された成人報告8,156件を解析し、うち1,109件がcase定義を満たした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の泌尿生殖器感染症報告は分子（DAPA vs EMPA）ではなく適応と性別に依存する。EEA報告ではDAPAとEMPA間で有意な差は認められず、女性性が最も強い決定因子であった（DAPA ROR 1.85、EMPA ROR 1.58）。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬はT2DM・CHF・CKDの複数適応で広く使用されているが、泌尿生殖器感染症は依然として関連する安全性懸念であり、適応別・性別に層別した比較的事後市場データは限られていた。本解析は、EudraVigilanceにおける薬剤間比較が報告の地理的由来に敏感であることを示し、安全性シグナルの解釈に重要な示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的薬物警戒分析（EudraVigilanceデータベースを用いたcase/non-case不均衡分析）
items.endpoints_ja: 泌尿生殖器感染症の報告不均衡比（ROR）：DAPA vs EMPA（全体・適応別・性別）、T2DM vs CHF間の報告差、生殖器真菌感染症への分解分析
items.sample_size_ja: EEA由来ICSR 16,102件中、適応が確認された成人報告8,156件を解析（うちcase定義を満たした1,109件）。非EEA報告は感度分析として別途解析。

items.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Analog-Type Amyloidosis: A Case Report and Review of the Literature.
items.abstract: Amyloidosis is a heterogeneous group of diseases characterized by extracellular deposition of insoluble proteins. Glucagon-like peptide-1 analog (AGLP1)-type amyloidosis is a rare iatrogenic form of amyloidosis localized to areas of glucagon-like peptide-1 analog injections. In this study, we describe a case of AGLP1-type amyloidosis presenting as a subcutaneous mass on the abdomen of a 71-year-old woman with a history of liraglutide, semaglutide, and tirzepatide use. Biopsy, including Congo red stain, was consistent with an amyloid deposit. Amyloid protein identification by liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry showed a typical amyloid profile with low spectra for liraglutide. Immunohistochemistry, subsequently performed, showed that the amyloid deposits were positive for glucagon; there is an extensive peptide homology between liraglutide and glucagon. Only 3 cases of AGLP1-type amyloidosis have been previously reported. It is vital for clinicians and pathologists to be aware of AGLP1-type amyloidosis given the increasing worldwide use of GLP-1 agonists, as well as the potential for misdiagnosis of systemic amyloidosis, which has profound therapeutic and prognostic implications.
items.authors: Loggie John, McKay Robert C, Nasr Samih H, Stueck Ashley
items.summary_ja: 71歳の女性で、リラグルチド、セマグルチド、チルゼパチドの既往があり、腹部の皮下腫瘤として発症したGLP-1アナログ型アミロイドーシス（AGLP1型アミロイドーシス）の症例を報告した。生検およびコンゴレッド染色でアミロイド沈着と一致し、LC-MS/MSではリラグルチドの低スペクトルを伴う典型的なアミロイドプロファイルが示された。免疫組織化学ではグルカゴン陽性であった（リラグルチドとグルカゴンの間で広範なペプチド相同性があるため）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: AGLP1型アミロイドーシスはGLP-1アナログ注射部位に局在する希少な医原性アミロイドーシスであり、全身性アミロイドーシスとの誤診を避けるために臨床医・病理医の認識が重要である。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1アゴニストの世界的な使用増加に伴い、AGLP1型アミロイドーシスの認識が重要であり、全身性アミロイドーシスとの誤診は治療および予後に関わる重大な影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

items.title: Combined time-restricted feeding and resistance training enhance tirzepatide-induced improvements in adiposity and whole-body insulin sensitivity in female mice.
items.abstract: Tirzepatide is a dual agonist of glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptors with potent effects on body weight regulation, glucose homeostasis and metabolic health. However, its interaction with dietary and exercise interventions as well as its impact on obesity and hepatic metabolic pathways, particularly in females, remain unclear. Here, we tested whether tirzepatide, alone or combined with time-restricted feeding (TRF) or resistance training, modulates energy balance, strength performance, adipose tissue remodelling, insulin sensitivity and hepatic lipid accumulation in female mice. Female Swiss mice after 10 weeks of obesity induction were treated with tirzepatide, TRF or resistance training for 8 weeks. Tirzepatide was administered subcutaneously using a dose-escalation protocol. TRF consisted of a 12 h feeding window, and resistance training was performed as stair climbing on alternating days. Body weight, caloric intake and feed efficiency were monitored longitudinally. Glucose homeostasis was assessed by intraperitoneal glucose and insulin tolerance tests. Adipose depots, skeletal muscle and liver mass were quantified, and hepatic lipid accumulation was evaluated by histology and RT-qPCR of lipogenic metabolism genes. Tirzepatide reduced body weight gain and feed efficiency, consistent with a negative energy balance. When combined with TRF and resistance training, tirzepatide accelerated weight loss, and the addition of resistance training further enhanced this effect, bringing body weight close to control levels. These effects were associated with reduced adipose mass and adipocyte hypertrophy, indicating improved adipose tissue remodelling. Resistance training improved strength performance and increased skeletal muscle mass. Tirzepatide combined with TRF, with or without resistance training, improved glucose tolerance in female mice. All interventions reduced hepatic lipid accumulation. Collectively, tirzepatide, particularly in combination with TRF and resistance training, exerts enhanced metabolic benefits on obesity, insulin sensitivity and metabolic regulation in female mice. KEY POINTS: Tirzepatide combined with time-restricted feeding and resistance training produced greater reductions in body weight and adiposity in obese female mice. Combined interventions improved whole-body insulin sensitivity more effectively than isolated strategies. Resistance training preserved skeletal muscle mass during tirzepatide-induced weight loss. All interventions similarly reduced hepatic lipid accumulation and lipogenic gene expression. Tirzepatide-based therapies enhanced systemic metabolic health without additional hepatic benefits from combined interventions.
items.authors: Macêdo Ana Paula Azevêdo, da Conceição de Mattis Luciana Renata, de Lima Robson Damasceno, Barbosa Louise Ailey, Pinotti Camila Barboza, Brisque Guilherme Domingos, Dias Larissa Moreira, Pitoli Beatriz de Souza
items.summary_ja: 肥満誘導後の雌性Swissマウスにおいて、tirzepatide単独、時間制限食事(TRF)、レジスタンストレーニングの単独または併用が、エネルギーバランス、筋力パフォーマンス、脂肪組織リモデリング、インスリン感受性、肝脂肪蓄積に与える影響を8週間評価した介入研究。
items.key_takeaway_ja: TirzepatideをTRFおよびレジスタンストレーニングと併用することで、肥満雌性マウスにおける体重減少・脂肪量減少・インスリン感受性改善が単独介入よりもさらに増強された。
items.why_matters_ja: TirzepatideはGIP/GLP-1二重作動薬として体重調節・グルコース恒常性・代謝健康に強力な効果を持つが、食事・運動介入との相互作用、特に雌性における肥満や肝代謝経路への影響は不明であった。本研究は、tirzepatideベースの療法に生活習慣介入を組み合わせることで代謝的利点を増強できる可能性を示した。
items.study_type_ja: 動物介入研究（雌性マウス、対照群を含む複数群比較）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、カロリー摂取量、給餌効率、腹腔内グルコース耐性試験(IPGTT)、腹腔内インスリン耐性試験(IITT)、脂肪組織量、骨格筋量、肝臓重量、肝脂肪蓄積（組織学的評価および脂肪生成代謝遺伝子のRT-qPCR）、筋力パフォーマンス

items.title: Early Treatment Trajectory and Long-Term Persistence to Semaglutide for Obesity: A Population-Based Cohort Study.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To assess semaglutide persistence in obesity management, identify factors associated with discontinuation and examine early tirzepatide adoption.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used Clalit Health Services records of adults without diabetes initiating Wegovy between January and May 2025. Discontinuation was defined as a gap exceeding 60 days after medication coverage ended. Multivariable Cox models, including a Day-90 landmark analysis, assessed discontinuation. Tirzepatide adoption was evaluated following its December 2025 coverage introduction.
RESULTS: Among 34 309 participants (67.0% women; mean age 44.6 years), cumulative discontinuation reached 36.5% at 180 days and 67.6% at 365 days. Arab population sector (hazard ratio [HR] 1.65, 95% CI 1.59-1.72), low socioeconomic status (HR 1.13, 95% CI 1.09-1.17) and current smoking (HR 1.13, 95% CI 1.09-1.17) were associated with discontinuation. In the day-90 landmark cohort (n = 28 218), remaining on 0.25 versus 1.0 mg was associated with subsequent discontinuation (HR 1.88, 95% CI 1.72-2.06), substantially attenuated after adjustment for early refill adherence. Each percentage-point smaller BMI reduction was associated with 3% higher discontinuation hazard (HR 1.03, 95% CI 1.03-1.04). Following tirzepatide availability, 2908 of 33 936 eligible participants (8.6%) initiated treatment over a median 3.1-month observation period. Adoption was associated with higher socioeconomic status and baseline BMI.
CONCLUSIONS: Semaglutide discontinuation was common and associated with sociodemographic and early treatment characteristics. Day-90 dose and early weight-loss response may help identify discontinuation risk. Socioeconomic differences suggest inequalities in sustained obesity pharmacotherapy access.
items.authors: Winter Eitan, Wolff Sagy Yael, Reges Orna, Feldhamer Ilan, Abu Ahmad Wiessam, Arbel Ronen, Dicker Dror, Lavie Gil
items.summary_ja: Clalit Health Servicesの記録を用いた後方視コホート研究。2025年1月から5月に糖尿病を有さない成人がWegovy（セマグルチド）を開始した34,309例を対象に、セマグルチドの継続率（persistence）、中止に関連する因子、およびtirzepatideの早期導入を評価した。中止は薬剤給付終了後60日を超えるギャップと定義し、Day-90ランドマーク解析を含む多変量Coxモデルで解析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドの中止は頻発し（180日時点で36.5%、365日時点で67.6%）、Day-90時点の投与量（0.25 mg vs 1.0 mg）および早期の体重減少反応が中止リスクの識別に有用である可能性が示された。また、社会経済的格差が持続的な肥満薬物療法へのアクセスの不平等を反映している。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満薬物療法の長期継続は治療効果の維持に不可欠であり、早期に中止リスクを予測できる因子（Day-90の投与量・早期体重減少反応）を特定できれば、臨床現場での介入タイミングの最適化や患者選定に活用できる。さらに、社会経済的要因によるアクセス格差の存在は、公衆衛生上の公平性問題として政策提言の根拠となる。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（population-based）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：セマグルチドの中止（persistence）。二次エンドポイント：中止に関連する因子の同定、tirzepatideの早期導入率。

items.title: SGLT2 Inhibitors and Risk of Postmenopausal Bleeding in Women: An Active-Comparator, New-User Cohort Study.
items.abstract:
AIMS: A recent case report and pharmacovigilance reports have suggested a possible association between sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors and postmenopausal bleeding (PMB), but population-level evidence is lacking. We evaluated the risk of PMB among women aged 55-90 years initiating SGLT2 inhibitors versus dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4) inhibitors.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We conducted an active-comparator, new-user cohort study using data from the All of Us Research Program. Women aged 55-90 years who newly initiated either an SGLT2 inhibitor or a DPP-4 inhibitor were included. The primary outcome was the first recorded PMB during follow-up. Propensity score (PS) matching, with exact matching on calendar period, was used to control for confounding. Hazard ratios (HRs) and incidence rate ratios (IRRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated using Cox and Poisson regression models.
RESULTS: Among 2603 women, 1328 initiated SGLT2 inhibitors and 1275 initiated DPP-4 inhibitors. After 1:1 PS matching, 650 pairs achieved good covariate balance. In the matched cohort, 37 and 34 PMB events occurred over 2248.2 and 2374.2 person-years, respectively. SGLT2 inhibitor initiation was not associated with increased PMB risk (HR 1.14, 95% CI 0.70-1.84; IRR 1.15, 95% CI 0.71-1.87). Sensitivity analyses were consistent with the primary findings.
CONCLUSIONS: SGLT2 inhibitor initiation was not associated with a significantly increased PMB risk compared with DPP-4 inhibitor initiation. These findings did not provide evidence of increased PMB risk with SGLT2 inhibitor therapy, although wide confidence intervals and limited outcome events warrant confirmation in larger studies.
items.authors: Choi Jung Yoon, Suh Sung Yun, Lee Hee Min, Lewis Susan J, Rhie Sandy Jeong
items.summary_ja: All of Us Research Programのデータを用いたアクティブ・コンパレーター・ニューユーザーコホート研究。55〜90歳の女性において、SGLT2阻害薬の開始がDPP-4阻害薬の開始と比較して閉経後出血（PMB）のリスクを高めるかを評価した。2603例（SGLT2阻害薬1328例、DPP-4阻害薬1275例）を登録し、1:1の傾向スコアマッチングにより650対を解析対象とした。マッチング後コホートにおいて、SGLT2阻害薬群で37例、DPP-4阻害薬群で34例のPMB事象が観察された。SGLT2阻害薬の開始はPMBリスクの有意な増加とは関連しなかった（HR 1.14, 95% CI 0.70-1.84; IRR 1.15, 95% CI 0.71-1.87）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の開始は、DPP-4阻害薬の開始と比較して閉経後出血のリスクを有意に増加させなかった。ただし、信頼区間が広く、アウトカム事象数が限られているため、より大規模な研究での確認が必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬と閉経後出血の関連を示唆する症例報告や薬物警戒報告が存在したが、集団レベルのエビデンスは不足していた。本研究は、この懸念に対する集団レベルのエビデンスを提供するものである。
items.study_type_ja: アクティブ・コンパレーター・ニューユーザーコホート研究（観察研究）
items.endpoints_ja: フォローアップ期間中に初めて記録された閉経後出血（PMB）
items.endpoint_results_ja: SGLT2阻害薬群：37例のPMB事象（2248.2 person-years）、DPP-4阻害薬群：34例のPMB事象（2374.2 person-years）。HR 1.14（95% CI 0.70-1.84）、IRR 1.15（95% CI 0.71-1.87）。

items.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Decrease the Rate of Rupture, Cardiac Events, and Death in Patients with Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) is a degenerative condition involving several processes including inflammation, matrix remodeling, disruptions of vascular smooth muscle cells, and thrombus formation all leading to progressive dilatation of the aorta and eventual rupture. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) are now considered part of the frontline therapeutic options to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus and have also been validated as having compelling anti-inflammatory and cardiovascular protective properties. Data is limited on the impact of GLP-1RA on outcomes of patients with AAA. The aim of this study is to examine the association and possible impact of GLP-1RA on patients with AAA.
METHODS: Data was sourced from the TriNetX research network, encompassing 123 health care organizations. Utilizing ICD-10 and CPT codes, we identified patients with AAA who received abdominal imaging every six months. Group 1 was comprised of patients who were treated with GLP-1RA while Group 2 patients were not. Propensity-score-matching (PSM) was used in a 1:1 fashion using age, sex, diabetes, metformin use, hypertension, cardiac disease, tobacco use, chronic kidney disease, and pulmonary disease as covariates. Primary outcomes were aneurysm rupture or repair. Secondary outcomes include mortality and major adverse cardiac events (MACE; myocardial infarction, stroke, and heart failure). Standard statistical methods were used as appropriate.
RESULTS: We identified 412,490 patients with diagnosis of AAA who were undergoing 6-month surveillance between June 1, 2010 and April 16, 2024. After PSM, the GLP-1RA group (N=13,722) underwent fewer elective repairs at each timepoint (1.5% vs 2.3% at 2 years, 2.1% vs 3.0% at 5 years, P<.01) and had significantly fewer ruptures at two years (1.1% vs 1.8%, P<.01) and five years (1.6% vs 2.4%, P<.01) when compared to Group 2 (N=13,722). Group 1 also experienced significantly fewer MACE and all-cause mortality at two and five years. On multivariate analysis, GLP-1RA significantly reduced the risk of undergoing elective repair (HR 0.757, 95% CI [0.636-0.902], P<.01), rupture (HR 0.538, 95% CI [0.418-0.691], P<.01), all-cause mortality (HR 0.474, 95% CI [0.439-0.511], P<.001), and MACE (HR 0.825, 95% CI [0.794-0.857], P<.01) at 5 years.
CONCLUSIONS: The use of GLP-1RA in patients with AAA is associated with fewer ruptures, elective repairs, and improved rates of MACE and death. A prospective analysis may further elucidate if GLP-1RA should be prescribed to reduce the rate of aneurysm growth.
items.authors: Go Catherine C, Alcantara Ana Clara Morellato, Annie Frank, Drabish Kerry, Eslami Mohammad H
items.summary_ja: TriNetX研究ネットワーク（123の医療機関）から、2010年6月1日から2024年4月16日までに6か月間隔で腹部画像検査を受けていた腹大動脈瘤（AAA）患者412,490例を同定した。傾向スコアマッチング（1:1、年齢・性別・糖尿病・メトホルミン使用・高血圧・心疾患・喫煙・慢性腎臓病・肺疾患を共変量として）後、GLP-1RA群（N=13,722）と非GLP-1RA群（N=13,722）を比較した。GLP-1RA群は、2年・5年時点での選択的修復術、破裂、主要不良心血管事象（MACE）、全死因死亡率が有意に低かった。多変量解析では、5年時点で選択的修復術（HR 0.757）、破裂（HR 0.538）、全死因死亡率（HR 0.474）、MACE（HR 0.825）のリスクが有意に低減した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 腹大動脈瘤患者におけるGLP-1RAの使用は、破裂・選択的修復術・MACE・死亡の発生率の低減と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: 腹大動脈瘤は炎症・マトリクスリモデリング・血管平滑筋細胞の障害・血栓形成を伴う進行性疾患であり、破裂リスクの管理は臨床的に重要である。GLP-1RAは既に2型糖尿病の第一線治療として確立されており、抗炎症・心血管保護作用も示されているが、AAA患者への影響に関するデータは限られていた。本研究は、既存のGLP-1RAがAAAの予後改善に寄与する可能性を示唆し、AAA管理における新たな治療戦略の検討を促すものである。
items.study_type_ja: 大規模データベース（TriNetX）を用いた後向きコホート研究（傾向スコアマッチングによる1:1マッチング）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：動脈瘤破裂または修復術。二次エンドポイント：全死因死亡率、主要不良心血管事象（MACE：心筋梗塞、脳卒中、心不全）。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 選択的修復術：2年時点 1.5% vs 2.3%（P<.01）、5年時点 2.1% vs 3.0%（P<.01）。破裂：2年時点 1.1% vs 1.8%（P<.01）、5年時点 1.6% vs 2.4%（P<.01）。MACE：2年・5年時点で有意に低かった（具体的な数値は記載なし）。全死因死亡率：2年・5年時点で有意に低かった（具体的な数値は記載なし）。多変量解析（5年時点）：選択的修復術 HR 0.757（95% CI 0.636-0.902, P<.01）、破裂 HR 0.538（95% CI 0.418-0.691, P<.01）、全死因死亡率 HR 0.474（95% CI 0.439-0.511, P<.001）、MACE HR 0.825（95% CI 0.794-0.857, P<.01）。

items.title: Semaglutide versus other GLP-1 RAs and cardiovascular risk in obesity-related cancer survivors.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Obesity-related cancer (ORCa) survivors are a unique population often excluded from landmark GLP-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) trials. Given their cardiovascular risks, we investigated whether semaglutide initiation, compared with other GLP-1 RA, was associated with modified 3-point major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) among ORCa survivors with type 2 diabetes (T2D).
METHODS: We emulated a target trial using PCORnet-UTSW electronic health records (2016-2025). Adults with ORCa and T2D initiating semaglutide versus other GLP-1 RA were included. The primary outcome was modified 3-point MACE (myocardial infarction, stroke, or all-cause mortality). Cumulative incidence risk (CIR), risk difference (RD), and hazard ratio (HR) were estimated in 1:1 propensity score-matched cohort.
RESULTS: Among 918 matched patients (semaglutide, n = 459; other GLP-1 RA, n = 459), 124 modified 3-point MACE occurred. The 5-year CIR% was 17.6 (95% CI, 12.3-22.9) for semaglutide and 26.6 (95% CI, 20.7-32.6) for other GLP-1 RA. Semaglutide was associated with lower modified 3-point MACE risk (RD%, -7.41 [95% CI, -11.83 to - 2.98];HR, 0.65 [95% CI, 0.44-0.94]) than other GLP-1 RA. Findings were largely consistent across high-risk subgroups.
CONCLUSIONS: Semaglutide was associated with a lower modified 3-point MACE risk than other GLP-1 RA. These findings suggest potential heterogeneity in cardioprotective effects and warrant confirmation.
items.authors: Abdelgadir Omer, Hernández-Pérez Jesus Gibran, Hussain Maryam R, Mendoza Kenny, Mian Rabiya K, Albayyaa Mohanad, Hughes Amy, Almandoz Jaime P
items.summary_ja: 肥満関連がん（ORCa）生存者かつ2型糖尿病（T2D）の成人において、セマグルチド開始群と他のGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）群を比較し、修正3点MACE（心筋梗塞、脳卒中、全死因死亡）のリスクを評価した。PCORnet-UTSW電子カルテ（2016-2025）を用いたターゲットトライアルエミュレーションであり、1:1プロパティスコアマッチングコホートで解析した。918名のマッチング患者（セマグルチド群459名、他のGLP-1 RA群459名）中、124例で修正3点MACEが発生した。5年累積発生リスク（CIR）はセマグルチド群17.6%（95% CI, 12.3-22.9）、他のGLP-1 RA群26.6%（95% CI, 20.7-32.6）であり、セマグルチド群で有意に低かった（RD, -7.41% [95% CI, -11.83 to -2.98]; HR, 0.65 [95% CI, 0.44-0.94]）。高リスクサブグループでも結果は概ね一致した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満関連がん生存者かつT2D患者において、セマグルチドは他のGLP-1 RAと比較して修正3点MACEリスクを有意に低減した（HR 0.65）。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満関連がん生存者はランドマークGLP-1 RA試験からしばしば除外される独自の集団であり、心血管リスクが高いにもかかわらず、この集団におけるGLP-1 RA間の心血管保護効果の差に関するエビデンスが不足していた。本研究は、セマグルチドと他のGLP-1 RAの心血管保護効果に異質性が存在する可能性を示唆し、この未解決の臨床的ギャップに答えるものである。
items.study_type_ja: ターゲットトライアルエミュレーション（電子カルテを用いた観察研究、1:1プロパティスコアマッチングコホート）
items.endpoints_ja: 修正3点MACE（心筋梗塞、脳卒中、全死因死亡）
items.sample_size_ja: 918名（セマグルチド群 n = 459; 他のGLP-1 RA群 n = 459）

items.title: Comparative Effects of Pharmacological Treatment on Heart Failure with Mildly Reduced or Preserved Ejection Fraction: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The comparative efficacy and safety of the new drugs (including sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors [SGLT-2Is], glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists [GLP-1RAs], non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists [nsMRAs], and soluble guanylate cyclase stimulators [sGCs]) for heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved (HFmrEF/HFpEF) ejection fraction remains largely unclear. We conducted a systematic review and network meta-analysis to evaluate their comparative effects on HFmrEF/HFpEF, aiming to provide evidence-based guidance for treatment selection.
METHODS: MEDLINE, EMBASE, Web of Science, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were comprehensively searched. We included randomized controlled trials that compared nsMRA, sGC, SGLT-2I, and GLP-1RA with placebo for patients with HFmrEF/HFpEF. Primary efficacy outcomes were cardiovascular (CV) death, hospitalization for heart failure (HF hospitalization), and all-cause mortality, while primary safety outcomes were adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs). The main analysis was conducted to compare the effects on HFmrEF/HFpEF between individual drugs. A frequentist network meta-analysis with random-effects models was used to calculate risk ratios (RRs) for dichotomous outcomes and standardized mean differences (SMDs) for continuous outcomes.
RESULTS: A total of 20 randomized controlled trials (RCTs, including 10 drugs from 35 publications) were included for analyses, but none provided head-to-head direct comparisons. No significant differences among all the individual drugs were found in risks of CV death or all-cause mortality.
