items.title: Modern antidiabetic therapy in older adults with type 2 diabetes: evidence, best practice and a clinical pharmacist's framework.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Older adults with type 2 diabetes require treatment that balances cardiovascular and kidney protection against hypoglycemia, treatment burden, undernutrition, and functional vulnerability.
AREAS COVERED: This narrative review considers PubMed-indexed literature and ClinicalTrials.gov records covering January 2010-October 2026, with targeted updating on 12 October 2026. It examines sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, tirzepatide, and dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors. Age-stratified outcome evidence is distinguished from whole-trial results and the limited evidence in adults aged 80 years or older. Body-composition findings, neurodegenerative outcomes, kidney-protective treatment, and pharmacist-supported regimen modification are critically appraised.
EXPERT OPINION: Organ protection and glycemic simplification should be considered separately. Frailty is not synonymous with kidney impairment, and reductions in lean mass do not establish treatment-induced sarcopenia. Weight-neutral therapy remains useful when weight loss is undesirable. A structured medication review should integrate patient priorities, nutrition, physical performance, renal function, and hypoglycemia risk, followed by explicit monitoring and communication across care transitions. Prospective validation of this integrated framework in the oldest and most vulnerable populations is needed.
items.authors: Martinc Boštjan, Šabovič Mišo, Janić Miodrag, Lunder Mojca
items.summary_ja: 2010年1月から2026年10月までのPubMed索引文献およびClinicalTrials.gov記録を対象としたナラティブレビュー。高齢の2型糖尿病患者におけるSGLT2阻害薬、GLP-1受容体作動薬、tirzepatide、DPP-4阻害薬の最新治療を考察し、年齢層別アウトカムエビデンス、体組成、神経変性アウトカム、腎保護治療、薬剤師支援によるレジメン変更を批判的に評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 臓器保護と血糖管理の簡素化は別々に考慮すべきである。フレイルは腎機能障害と同義ではない。減量中立的療法は減量が望ましくない場合に有用である。患者の優先事項、栄養、身体機能、腎機能、低血糖リスクを統合した構造化された薬剤レビューを行い、ケア移行時の明示的なモニタリングとコミュニケーションを行うべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 高齢の2型糖尿病患者では、心血管・腎保護と低血糖、治療負担、栄養不足、機能脆弱性のバランスが求められる。80歳以上の成人におけるエビデンスは限られており、最も高齢で脆弱な集団における統合フレームワークの前瞻性検証が未解決の課題である。
items.study_type_ja: ナラティブレビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 年齢層別アウトカムエビデンス、体組成、神経変性アウトカム、腎保護治療

items.title: The Veterans Affairs Pentoxifylline in Diabetic Kidney Disease (VA PTXRx) Study: Baseline Characteristics.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Experimental and clinical data suggest that the non-specific phosphodiesterase inhibitor pentoxifylline (PTX) reduces proteinuria and may delay the progression of diabetic kidney disease (DKD). However, no large-scale randomized clinical trial has determined whether PTX can reduce end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) and mortality in DKD.
DESIGN: VA PTXRx is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, multicenter clinical trial designed to test the hypothesis that PTX, when added to usual care, prolongs the time to kidney failure or death in type 2 diabetic (T2D) participants with DKD compared to usual care plus placebo. Enrolled participants at very high risk for ESKD and/or death were randomized in a 1:1 ratio to either PTX 400 mg twice daily or matching placebo using randomly permuted blocks with stratification for site, renin-angiotensin-aldosterone (RAAS) inhibitor use, and chronic kidney disease (CKD) stage. The study is event-driven, requiring 646 primary events (ESKD (chronic dialysis or transplantation) or death) to achieve 80% power to detect a relative risk reduction of 19% with PTX.
BASELINE RESULTS: Between December 2019 and November 2025, 2376 participants at 34 VA sites in the USA were randomized. The mean age at randomization was 72.3 years (SD 7.7), with 97% being male. The mean baseline eGFR was 33.3 mL/min/1.73 m2 (SD 9.4). The median urinary albumin to creatinine ratio (UACR) was 401 mg/g (IQR 122-1076). At baseline, the usage of RAAS inhibitors was 80.0%, sodium-glucose transporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors 52.9%, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists 33.2%, and finerenone 3.0%. The majority (88%) of participants had stage 3B or 4 CKD (eGFR < 45 mL/min/1.73m2).
CONCLUSIONS: The results, anticipated in 2027, are expected to determine whether PTX is a treatment option for patients with high-risk DKD. Because PTX is a generic medication, it is inexpensive in many health systems, which would facilitate access if it proves effective. Trial Registration: This study is registered with clinicaltrials.gov (Identifier: NCT03625648).
items.journal: Nephrology, dialysis, transplantation : official publication of the European Dialysis and Transplant Association - European Renal Association
items.authors: Leehey David J, Agarwal Rajiv, Xing Bin, Clise Christina, Navaneethan Sankar, Utzschneider Kristina, Lammie Douglas, Wei Yongliang
items.summary_ja: VA PTXRx試験は、非特異的ホスホジエステラーゼ阻害薬ペンタキシフィル（PTX）が2型糖尿病性腎症（DKD）患者の腎不全または死亡までの時間を延長するかを検証する、無作為化・二重盲検・プラセボ対照・並行群・多施設臨床試験である。2019年12月から2025年11月までに、米国34箇所のVA施設で2,376名が1:1でPTX 400 mg 1日2回またはプラセボに無作為化された。本論文はベースライン特性の報告であり、平均年齢72.3歳、男性97%、平均ベースラインeGFR 33.3 mL/min/1.73 m²、中央値UACR 401 mg/g、CKD 3B期または4期が88%であった。結果は2027年に発表予定。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 本論文はVA PTXRx試験のベースライン特性の報告であり、2,376名が無作為化されたことを示している。PTXがDKD患者のESKDまたは死亡を減少させるかどうかの最終結果は2027年に発表予定である。
items.why_matters_ja: PTXはジェネリック医薬品であり、多くの医療システムで安価であるため、有効性が証明されればアクセスが容易になる。これまでPTXがDKDにおけるESKDや死亡率を減少させるかどうかを決定した大規模無作為化臨床試験は存在しなかった。
items.study_type_ja: 無作為化・二重盲検・プラセボ対照・並行群・多施設臨床試験（ベースライン特性の報告）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：腎不全（ESKD：慢性透析または移植）または死亡までの時間。イベント駆動型で、646件の主要イベント（相対リスク19%の減少を検出する80%の検出力）が必要。
items.sample_size_ja: 2,376名（米国34箇所のVA施設で無作為化）

items.title: Transient Adipose Inflammatory Remodeling during High-Dose Semaglutide-Induced Weight Loss and Regain.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Weight loss improves obesity-associated metabolic dysfunction, yet resolution of adipose inflammation may be incomplete and can reappear during weight regain. Whether high-dose semaglutide induces sustained immunological remodeling of adipose and hepatic tissues during weight cycling remains unclear.
METHODS: Male C57BL/6 mice with diet-induced obesity were treated with semaglutide (60 nmol/kg, intraperitoneally, every 3 days) or vehicle for 3 weeks, followed by drug withdrawal under continued high-fat diet feeding. Body weight, body composition, and glucose homeostasis were assessed during treatment and after weight regain. Inflammatory changes in visceral and subcutaneous adipose tissue and liver were analyzed by flow cytometry, histology, immunofluorescence, and gene expression profiling.
RESULTS: Semaglutide induced rapid fat mass-selective weight loss with preservation of lean mass and significantly improved fasting glucose, insulin levels, insulin sensitivity, and glucose tolerance. During treatment, visceral adipose tissue exhibited marked reductions in pro-inflammatory macrophages, crown-like structures, and inflammatory gene expression, whereas subcutaneous adipose tissue was minimally affected. Following withdrawal, mice rapidly regained weight and adiposity. Visceral adipose inflammation fully reverted, with macrophage infiltration and inflammatory gene expression comparable to chronically obese controls. Hepatic steatosis and inflammatory markers similarly returned to obese levels. Despite this tissue-level reversion, fasting glycemia and insulin levels remained partially improved.
CONCLUSION: High-dose semaglutide induces robust metabolic improvement and transient suppression of visceral adipose inflammation during active treatment; however, these inflammatory changes are not sustained after withdrawal and largely revert with weight regain. In contrast, partial improvement in fasting glycemia persisted, suggesting differential durability between systemic metabolic adaptation and local inflammatory remodeling during pharmacological weight cycling.
items.authors: Seo Mihye, Julietta Vivi, Averia Maria, Soedono Shindy, Budiono Ellen, Park Hyeong Kyu, Suh Kyoil, Cho Kae Won
items.summary_ja: 高用量セマグルチドによる体重減少と再増加時の脂肪組織の炎症性リモデリングを、食事誘発性肥満マウスモデルで評価した前臨床研究。セマグルチド投与中は内臓脂肪組織の炎症性マクロファージ、クラウン様構造、炎症性遺伝子発現が有意に減少し、空腹時血糖・インスリン値・インスリン感受性・グルコース耐性が改善した。投与中止後の体重再増加に伴い、内臓脂肪炎症は慢性肥満対照群と同等レベルまで完全に回復し、肝脂肪変性および炎症マーカーも同様に肥満レベルに戻った。一方、空腹時血糖とインスリン値は部分的に改善が持続した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 高用量セマグルチドによる内臓脂肪炎症の抑制は投与中の一時的なものであり、投与中止後の体重再増加に伴いほぼ完全に回復する。一方、空腹時血糖の改善は部分的に持続し、全身的な代謝適応と局所的な炎症性リモデリングの持続性に差があることを示唆する。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満治療薬による体重減少後の炎症の再発機序を理解することは、治療中断後の代謝リスク評価や、持続的な炎症抑制を目的とした治療戦略の開発に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床研究（動物実験）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、体組成、空腹時血糖、インスリン値、インスリン感受性、グルコース耐性、内臓脂肪組織および皮下脂肪組織の炎症性変化（フローサイトメトリー、組織学、免疫蛍光、遺伝子発現プロファイリング）、肝脂肪変性および炎症マーカー

items.title: Glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) signaling in visceral and subcutaneous adipose tissue: implications for obesity and metabolic disease-a narrative review with a structured literature search.
items.abstract: Glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide is one of the principal incretin hormones involved in the regulation of glucose homeostasis, lipid metabolism, and adipocyte function. Increasing evidence indicates that its biological actions differ substantially between adipose tissue depots. The aim of this narrative review with a structured literature search was to summarize current evidence on the role of GIP in visceral adipose tissue (VAT) and subcutaneous adipose tissue (SAT), incorporating preclinical, clinical, and genetic data. Animal studies have demonstrated that VAT is characterized by higher expression of the GIP receptor (GIPR) and greater sensitivity to the lipogenic and proinflammatory effects of GIP. Activation of GIPR in VAT promotes lipid accumulation, inflammation, and insulin resistance. Conversely, pharmacological blockade or genetic deletion of GIPR confers protection against diet-induced obesity and leads to improvements in metabolic parameters. In SAT, GIP exerts more heterogeneous and metabolically context-dependent effects that differ according to insulin sensitivity and obesity status. Moreover, under specific conditions, GIP may promote lipolysis in SAT, distinguishing its actions in this depot from those observed in VAT. These observations may help explain the efficacy of dual and triple incretin receptor agonists, including tirzepatide and retatrutide, which produce significant improvements in body weight and metabolic outcomes. Collectively, current evidence supports a depot-specific and context-dependent role of GIP in adipose tissue biology and underscores the therapeutic potential of targeting the GIP/GIPR axis in obesity and metabolic disease.
items.authors: Smarkusz-Zarzecka Joanna, Radziszewska Marcelina, Gofron Krzysztof Ksawery, Ostrowska Lucyna
items.summary_ja: GIP（グルコース依存性インスリン熱促進ペプチド）が内臓脂肪組織（VAT）と皮下脂肪組織（SAT）に及ぼす役割に関する現在の証拠を、前臨床・臨床・遺伝子データを含めてまとめたナラティブレビュー（構造化文献検索付き）。動物研究では、VATはGIP受容体（GIPR）の発現が高く、GIPの脂肪合成促進・促炎作用に対してより敏感であることが示された。VATにおけるGIPRの活性化は脂質蓄積、炎症、インスリン抵抗性を促進する一方、GIPRの薬理学的阻害または遺伝的欠損は食餌誘発肥満から保護し、代謝パラメータの改善をもたらす。SATでは、GIPはインスリン感受性や肥満状態に応じて異なる異質で代謝的に文脈依存的な効果を発揮し、特定の条件下ではSATでリポリシスを促進しうる。これらの知見は、tirzepatideやretatrutideを含むデュアル・トリプルインクレチン受容体アゴニストの有効性を説明する助けとなる可能性がある。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GIPは脂肪組織の部位特異的かつ文脈依存的な役割を有しており、VATでは脂肪合成・炎症・インスリン抵抗性を促進する一方、SATでは条件次第でリポリシスを促進しうる。この部位特異性がGIP/GIPR軸を標的とした肥満・代謝疾患治療の潜在的可能性を裏付けている。
items.why_matters_ja: tirzepatideやretatrutideなどのデュアル・トリプルインクレチン受容体アゴニストが体重および代謝アウトカムに有意な改善をもたらすメカニズムを説明する枠組みを提供し、GIP/GIPR軸を標的とした肥満・代謝疾患治療の理論的根拠を強化する。
items.study_type_ja: ナラティブレビュー（構造化文献検索付き）
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Whether to hold and what to measure: perioperative euglycemic ketoacidosis in patients taking SGLT2 inhibitors.
items.abstract: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are widely used for type 2 diabetes, heart failure, and chronic kidney disease, including in patients without diabetes. Their ketogenic effects may be amplified perioperatively by fasting, surgical stress, and volume loss, resulting in ketoacidosis without marked hyperglycemia. Reported frequencies depend on ascertainment. Where ketones were measured against a diagnostic threshold, cohorts reported 0-1.8% in non-cardiac and mixed populations and 0-15.1% in cardiac surgery; one prospective study using a lower threshold (≥ 0.6 mmol/L) reported a far higher figure, and studies without ketone measurement reported surrogate metabolic-acidosis endpoints of 30-41%. None of these are comparable incidence estimates. Severe and fatal cases have been reported. Because plasma glucose may be normal, diagnosis requires attention to acid-base status and ketones. Quantitative blood β-hydroxybutyrate is preferred when SGLT2 inhibitor (SGLT2i)-associated ketoacidosis is suspected; urine ketone tests may screen when blood testing is unavailable, but a negative result does not exclude it. Perioperative guidance remains inconsistent: some bodies recommend withholding SGLT2i for 3 days (4 days for ertugliflozin), whereas others support risk-stratified continuation in selected patients under specified fasting and dietary conditions. No randomized trial has compared continuation with discontinuation using perioperative ketoacidosis as an endpoint; observational evidence remains limited and conflicting, and ketone thresholds and monitoring intervals lack prospective validation. This review summarizes evidence on recognition, diagnosis, withholding, monitoring, and postoperative restart.
items.authors: Park Eun Ji, Hong Jeong-Min
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬を使用する患者における術前・術後の正常血糖性ケトアシドーシスに関するレビュー。認識、診断、投与中止、モニタリング、術後再開に関する証拠を総括している。絶食、手術ストレス、体液喪失によりケトジェニック効果が増幅され、著明な高血糖を伴わないケトアシドーシスが生じ得る。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬使用者における術前・術後の正常血糖性ケトアシドーシスは重症・致死例が報告されており、診断には血糖値だけでなく酸塩基平衡とケトン体の評価が不可欠である。術前中止に関するガイドラインは不統一であり、中止と継続を比較したランダム化試験は存在しない。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は2型糖尿病、心不全、慢性腎臓病に広く使用されているが、術前・術後のケトアシドーシスは重症・致死例が報告されており、血糖値が正常であるため見逃されやすい。術前中止の推奨は機関によって異なり、ケトン体の閾値やモニタリング間隔のprospective検証が未実施であるため、臨床現場での判断が困難である。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 術前・術後の正常血糖性ケトアシドーシス（診断閾値に対するケトン体測定）、代理代謝性アシドーシスエンドポイント
items.endpoint_results_ja: 診断閾値に対するケトン体測定：非心臓・混合集団で0〜1.8%、心臓手術で0〜15.1%。低閾値（≥0.6 mmol/L）を用いた前向き研究ではより高い頻度が報告（具体的な数値は記載なし）。ケトン体測定なしの代理代謝性アシドーシスエンドポイント：30〜41%。

items.title: Emerging Therapeutic Strategies for Child and Adolescent Obesity: A Narrative Review.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Childhood obesity is a chronic, multifactorial disease requiring attention to biological, behavioral, psychological, family, and socioeconomic factors. This narrative review examined the integration of lifestyle, family-based, psychological, and pharmacological approaches, focusing on treatment engagement, eating disorders, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and treatment durability.
METHODS: A single search interface covering PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science (the University of Turin library discovery platform) was used to identify studies published primarily from 2010 to August 2026. Pediatric trials, observational studies, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, guidelines, and public-health reports were prioritized.
RESULTS: Intensive family-based, multicomponent behavioral treatment remains the best-supported foundation of care, although psychological outcomes are infrequently assessed. Psychiatric comorbidity is heterogeneous; loss-of-control eating, emotional symptoms, ADHD, and executive-function difficulties may impair engagement in selected patients, and untreated ADHD has been associated with a slower BMI response to weight management. Professionally supervised obesity treatment containing a dietary component did not, on average, worsen eating psychopathology and reduced several related symptoms. Family participation improved outcomes, whereas logistical, socioeconomic, and psychological barriers reduced attendance. Across randomized trials, adding anti-obesity medication to behavioral treatment produced an additional, although on average modest, reduction in BMI. Semaglutide, liraglutide, and phentermine/topiramate produced larger numerical reductions than older agents in separate trials, but heterogeneity and the absence of head-to-head comparisons preclude formal ranking. Gastrointestinal adverse events were frequent with glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists. Pediatric trials and real-world evidence indicate partial weight regain after discontinuation, while prescribing remains limited and unequal.
CONCLUSIONS: Pediatric obesity care should be phenotype-informed, multidisciplinary, and longitudinal. Pharmacotherapy can enhance BMI reduction but should complement rather than replace behavioral, psychological, and family care. Outcomes should extend beyond BMI to metabolic, psychological, functional, and long-term measures.
items.authors: Oliaro Tomaso, Amianto Federico
items.summary_ja: 小児・思春期肥満は生物学的・行動的・心理的・家庭的・社会的経済的要因を伴う慢性多因子疾患であり、本叙述的レビューは、生活習慣・家族ベース・心理的・薬物療法の統合的アプローチを、治療エンゲージメント、摂食障害、ADHD、治療の持続性に焦点を当てて検討した。PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Scienceを用い、主に2010年から2026年8月までに発表された小児試験、観察研究、系統的レビュー、メタアナリシス、ガイドライン、公衆衛生報告を優先的に検索した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 集約的家族ベースの多成分行動療法が最も根拠の強い基盤であるが、薬物療法（セマグルチド、リラグルチド、フェンテルミン/トピラマート）の追加はBMIのさらなる低下をもたらすものの、平均的には modest であり、行動的・心理的・家族的ケアを補完する位置づけであるべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 小児肥満の管理において、BMI以外の代謝的・心理的・機能的・長期アウトカムを重視した、フェノタイプに基づく多職種・長期アプローチの必要性を明確にし、薬物療法の位置づけと限界（GLP-1受容体作動薬の消化管有害事象の頻発、中止後の部分的重増量、処方機会の不平等）を整理している。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的レビュー（Narrative Review）
items.endpoints_ja: BMI変化、摂食病理（eating psychopathology）、心理的アウトカム、治療エンゲージメント（受診率）、中止後の体重再増加、消化管有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし（具体的な数値は提示されていない。行動療法に抗肥満薬を追加した際のBMI低下は「平均的には modest な追加的低下」とのみ記載され、セマグルチド・リラグルチド・フェンテルミン/トピラマートは旧薬より「より大きな数値的低下」を示したと記載されるが、具体的な数値は示されていない）

items.title: Chronic Intermittent Hypoxia and MASLD in Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Critical Appraisal of Mechanistic and Causal Evidence.
items.abstract: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) frequently coexist and share a common cardiometabolic substrate through a shared cardiometabolic substrate. This narrative review critically appraises the epidemiological, experimental, and interventional evidence proposed to link chronic intermittent hypoxia (CIH) and sleep fragmentation to hepatic steatosis, steatohepatitis, and fibrosis. We summarize the candidate mechanisms, including mitochondrial oxidative stress, hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha signaling, sympathetically driven lipolysis, and Kupffer and stellate cell activation and then examine the limits of the evidence supporting them: hypoxia-induced hypophagia and the scarcity of pair-fed controls in rodent models, species differences in the physiological response to hypoxia, publication bias, common-cause confounding by age and systemic inflammation, and the rarity of progressive liver disease in lean patients with anatomically driven OSA. We further review non-invasive diagnostic tools, polysomnographic hypoxemia indices, transient elastography, METS-IR, FIB-4, and emerging biomarkers, such as omentin-1 and follistatin-like 1, that enable bidirectional screening between sleep and hepatology clinics. Finally, we discuss therapeutic strategies, including continuous positive airway pressure, structured weight loss, and incretin-based pharmacotherapy (GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists), highlighting recent phase 3 evidence for tirzepatide in OSA and semaglutide in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis. Current evidence supports CIH as a context-dependent amplifier of liver injury in patients with pre-existing metabolic dysfunction rather than as an established independent cause of MASH. This interpretation still justifies integrated screening and treatment pathways, while identifying the study designs needed to test causality directly.
items.authors: Cebuc Simeanu Georgiana-Mihaela, Dragne Ioana-Gabriela, Mitrea Adina, Clenciu Diana, Protasiewicz-Timofticiuc Diana-Cristina, Popa Alina-Liliana, Mitroi Denisa-Maria, Pîrvu Bianca-Florentina
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸（OSA）と代謝機能異常関連脂肪性肝疾患（MASLD）の関連について、慢性間欠的低酸素（CIH）と睡眠断片化が肝脂肪症・脂肪性肝炎・線維症に与える影響を、疫学・実験・介入の各証拠から批判的に評価した叙述的レビューである。ミトコンドリア酸化ストレス、HIF-1αシグナル、交感神経介在の脂質分解、Kupffer細胞・星状細胞活性化などの候補メカニズムを整理するとともに、低酸素誘発性食欲低下とrodentモデルにおけるpair-fed対照の欠如、種差、出版バイアス、年齢・全身炎症による共通原因交絡、解剖学的OSAを有する痩せ患者における進行性肝疾患の希少性といった証拠の限界を指摘している。さらに、ポリソムノグラフィ低酸素指数、一過性弾性断層法、METS-IR、FIB-4、omentum-1、follistatin-like 1などの非侵襲的診断ツール、およびCPAP、構造化減量、インクレチン系薬物療法（GLP-1受容体作動薬、GIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬）の治療戦略についても論じている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 現在の証拠は、CIHが既存の代謝機能異常を有する患者において肝障害の文脈依存的な増幅因子として機能することを支持するが、MASHの確立された独立した原因としては位置づけられていない。
items.why_matters_ja: OSAとMASLDは頻繁に併存し、共通の心代謝基質を共有するため、睡眠科と肝臓科の双方向スクリーニングおよび統合的な治療パスウェイの整備が臨床的に重要である。因果関係を直接検証するための研究デザインの必要性も示唆されている。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的レビュー（Narrative Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 肝脂肪症、脂肪性肝炎（MASH）、肝線維症の発症・進展に関するCIHおよび睡眠断片化の因果的役割；非侵襲的診断ツール（ポリソムノグラフィ低酸素指数、一過性弾性断層法、METS-IR、FIB-4、omentum-1、follistatin-like 1）；治療戦略（CPAP、構造化減量、GLP-1受容体作動薬、GIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬）

items.title: Heterogeneous Renal Response to Therapy in Type 2 Diabetes: Albuminuria Categories.
items.abstract: Background: The comparative effectiveness of renin-angiotensin system (RAS) blockade and sodium-glucose cotransporter 2(SGLT2) inhibitors across different stages of albuminuria remain incompletely characterized despite demonstrating renoprotective association in randomized trials. This study evaluates the association between angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEI)/angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB), SGLT2 inhibitor, and their combination across baseline albuminuria strata. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study at Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare including adults with type 2 diabetes with baseline and follow-up measurements of eGFR and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) between January 2020 and December 2024. Patients were categorized into the following four groups: neither therapy, ACEI/ARB alone, SGLT2 inhibitor alone, and combination therapy. Analyses were stratified by baseline albuminuria category. Results: Among 10,252 participants, treatment groups comprised neither ACEI/ARB nor SGLT2 inhibitor therapy (n = 2142), ACEI/ARB monotherapy (n = 2332), SGLT2 inhibitor monotherapy (n = 1988), and combination therapy (n = 3790). In the entropy-balanced adjusted analysis, none of the treatment groups were significantly associated with the primary outcome of ≥30% eGFR decline compared with neither therapy. For the secondary outcome of ≥10% eGFR decline, higher adjusted odds were observed with ACEI/ARB monotherapy (OR, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.24-1.75) and combination therapy (OR, 1.62; 95% CI, 1.39-1.89), whereas SGLT2 inhibitor monotherapy was not significantly associated with the outcome. In the baseline-adjusted log-ACR analysis, higher adjusted geometric mean follow-up ACR was observed with ACEI/ARB monotherapy (GMR, 1.079; 95% CI, 1.007-1.155) and combination therapy (GMR, 1.203; 95% CI, 1.128-1.284); the association for SGLT2 inhibitor monotherapy was not statistically significant. In a binary threshold analysis, no treatment groups demonstrated a statistically significant association with achieving a ≥50% ACR decline compared to neither therapy. A significant treatment-by-baseline-ACR interaction was observed for ≥30% eGFR decline (p = 0.029). Conclusions: Overall, treatment group was not significantly associated with the primary outcome of ≥30% eGFR decline or a categorical ≥50% decline in ACR in the adjusted analysis. However, the significant interaction with baseline ACR indicates that the association between treatment group and eGFR decline varied across albuminuria categories. Variations in continuous eGFR change and baseline-adjusted continuous follow-up ACR differed across treatment groups, showing slight increases in geometric mean follow-up ACR for groups exposed to ACEI/ARBs.
items.authors: AlGhawi Rawan Jassim, Albanki Hesa Adel, Almahrous Lama Mohammed, Alabbasi Farah Ahmed, Zurkiyeh Mohammed, Alotaibi Anwar B, Alkhunaizi Ahmed M
items.summary_ja: Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcareにおける2型糖尿病成人を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。2020年1月から2024年12月までのeGFRと尿アルブミン/クレアチニン比（ACR）のベースラインおよびフォローアップ測定値を用い、ACEI/ARB、SGLT2阻害薬、およびその併用がベースラインアルブミン尿量カテゴリー別に腎機能に与える関連を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 主要アウトカムであるeGFR 30%以上の低下は、いずれの治療群も非治療群と比較して有意に関連しなかった。しかし、eGFR 30%以上の低下について治療群とベースラインACRの有意な交互作用（p = 0.029）が認められ、アルブミン尿量カテゴリー間で腎反応が異なっていることを示唆した。
items.why_matters_ja: RAS遮断薬とSGLT2阻害薬の比較効果は、アルブミン尿量の異なるステージ間で十分に特徴付けられていない。本研究は、実世界データにおいてアルブミン尿量カテゴリー別の腎反応の異質性を示し、個別化治療の根拠を提供する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的コホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：eGFR 30%以上の低下。二次アウトカム：eGFR 10%以上の低下、ベースライン補正log-ACR（連続変数）、ACR 50%以上の低下（二値閾値解析）。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要アウトカム（eGFR 30%以上の低下）：いずれの治療群も非治療群と比較して有意に関連しなかった。二次アウトカム（eGFR 10%以上の低下）：ACEI/ARB単独療法（OR, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.24-1.75）、併用療法（OR, 1.62; 95% CI, 1.39-1.89）で調整オッズ比が上昇、SGLT2阻害薬単独療法は有意に関連しなかった。ベースライン補正log-ACR：ACEI/ARB単独療法（GMR, 1.079; 95% CI, 1.007-1.155）、併用療法（GMR, 1.203; 95% CI, 1.128-1.284）でフォローアップACRの幾何平均が上昇、SGLT2阻害薬単独療法は統計的に有意ではなかった。ACR 50%以上の低下：いずれの治療群も非治療群と比較して有意に関連しなかった。eGFR 30%以上の低下における治療群×ベースラインACRの交互作用：p = 0.029。
items.sample_size_ja: 10,252名（非治療群 n = 2142、ACEI/ARB単独療法 n = 2332、SGLT2阻害薬単独療法 n = 1988、併用療法 n = 3790）

items.title: Relationship Between Social Isolation, Loneliness, and Systemic Inflammation: A Scoping Review of Biological Signatures and Clinical Outcomes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Social isolation and loneliness are established social determinants of health, associated with 25-30% higher mortality risk, yet their relationship with systemic inflammation and broader biological and clinical outcomes has not been comprehensively synthesized across life stages.
METHODS: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and ScienceDirect were searched (2015-2025), supplemented by citation searching and a targeted supplementary search, for human studies linking social isolation, loneliness, or social connectedness to inflammatory biomarkers or biological/clinical outcomes. PRISMA-ScR guidance was followed; findings were synthesized narratively across five thematic axes as an evidence map.
RESULTS: Of 3351 records identified, 73 studies were included. Isolation was most often associated with CRP and fibrinogen, and loneliness with IL-6. Isolation predicted sarcopenia, venous thromboembolism, pancreatic cancer, and cardiovascular disease, with inflammatory or metabolic markers mediating a modest (≈5-19%) share. Proteomic (n = 42,062) and epigenetic analyses linked loneliness to inflammatory, antiviral, and complement-pathway proteins and to accelerated epigenetic ageing; Mendelian randomization supported causal involvement of several proteins. Social connectedness and relationship quality tracked with lower IL-6 and better functional indices. Evidence was strongest in midlife and older cohorts.
CONCLUSIONS: Social disconnection shows biologically plausible but heterogeneous associations with inflammatory and molecular signatures; harmonized measurement and prospective, hypothesis-free omics designs are needed to clarify causality and inform targeted screening.
items.authors: Bechliouli Aimilia, Stylianakis Dimitrios, Spanakis Marios, Lionis Christos, Symvoulakis Emmanouil K
items.summary_ja: 社会的孤立・孤独と全身性炎症および生物学的・臨床的転帰との関係を、ライフステージ全体で包括的に統合したスコーピングレビューである。PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、ScienceDirect（2015-2025年）を検索し、PRISMA-ScRガイドラインに従って3,351件のレコードから73件の研究を抽出し、5つのテーマ軸に沿ってナラティブに統合した。孤立はCRP・フィブリノーゲン、孤独はIL-6との関連が最も頻繁に報告された。孤立はサルコペニア、静脈血栓塞栓症、膵癌、心血管疾患を予測し、炎症性・代謝性マーカーが約5-19%の割合で媒介していた。プロテオミクス解析（n=42,062）とエピゲノム解析は孤独と炎症性・抗ウイルス性・補体経路タンパク質およびエピゲノム加齢の加速との関連を示し、メンデルランダム化が複数のタンパク質の因果的関与を支持した。社会的つながりと関係の質は低いIL-6および良好な機能指標と関連した。証拠は中年期および高齢コホートで最も強かった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 社会的断絶は炎症性・分子シグネチャーと生物学的に妥当だが異質な関連を示しており、因果関係の明確化には調和された測定と前向き・仮説非依存のオミクスデザインが必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 社会的孤立・孤独は25-30%高い死亡率リスクと関連する確立された健康の社会的決定要因であり、全身性炎症を介した生物学的メカニズムの理解は、対象を絞ったスクリーニングや介入の根拠となる。
items.study_type_ja: スコーピングレビュー（PRISMA-ScR準拠）
items.endpoints_ja: 炎症性バイオマーカー（CRP、フィブリノーゲン、IL-6）、生物学的・臨床的転帰（サルコペニア、静脈血栓塞栓症、膵癌、心血管疾患）、プロテオミクス解析（炎症性・抗ウイルス性・補体経路タンパク質）、エピゲノム加齢、機能指標、死亡率
items.endpoint_results_ja: 死亡率リスク：25-30%高い（背景記載）。炎症性・代謝性マーカーの媒介割合：約5-19%。プロテオミクス解析対象：n=42,062。検索レコード数：3,351件。採用研究数：73件。
items.sample_size_ja: 検索レコード3,351件から73件の研究を採用。プロテオミクス解析の個別対象数はn=42,062と記載。レビュー全体の統合対象者数は抄録に記載なし。

items.title: Real-World Pharmacological Patterns and Residual Cardiometabolic Risk in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes in Romania.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Contemporary management of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) has shifted from a glucose-centered approach toward integrated cardio-renal-metabolic protection. Although sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), and intensive lipid-lowering therapies have demonstrated substantial cardiovascular and renal benefits, implementation in routine outpatient care and the burden of persistent residual risk remain insufficiently characterized in Romania.
OBJECTIVES: We aimed to evaluate routine-care pharmacological treatment patterns, identify residual cardio-renal-metabolic risk despite ongoing therapy, determine independent correlates of persistent adverse outcomes, and explore potential therapeutic gaps in adults with T2DM.
METHODS: This cross-sectional observational study included 232 unique adults with T2DM attending a specialized outpatient diabetes clinic in Romania between 1 October 2024 and 19 February 2026. One eligible outpatient record per participant was analyzed; when multiple records were available, the earliest eligible record in the exported dataset was used as the index visit. No a priori sample-size calculation was performed. Pharmacological therapies, cardiovascular and renal phenotypes, metabolic biomarkers, and clinical outcomes were extracted from routinely collected electronic medical records. Residual risk was evaluated using glycemic, lipid, renal, obesity, and blood-pressure targets. Multivariable logistic regression analyses identified independent correlates of persistent cardio-metabolic abnormalities. An exploratory cumulative residual-risk count was constructed by summing seven clinically relevant uncontrolled risk factors.
RESULTS: Biguanides were the most frequently prescribed glucose-lowering agents (53.0%), followed by SGLT2 inhibitors (44.8%), insulin (32.3% of the total cohort), GLP-1 receptor agonists (15.5%), and DPP-4 inhibitors (14.7%). Statins were prescribed to 48.7% of participants. SGLT2 inhibitor use did not differ significantly according to established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, heart failure, or chronic kidney disease phenotypes, whereas GLP-1 receptor agonists were prescribed more frequently in participants with obesity (22.0% vs. 7.6%, p = 0.003). Clinically important residual risk persisted across all treatment groups. Among SGLT2 inhibitor users, 57.3% had HbA1c ≥ 7%, while 27.9% remained albuminuric. Among insulin-treated participants, 84.0% had HbA1c ≥ 7%; reduced eGFR and albuminuria were also more frequent than among non-users. Despite statin therapy, 33.6% of treated participants continued to exhibit LDL cholesterol ≥ 100 mg/dL. In multivariable logistic regression, insulin therapy was associated with higher odds of HbA1c ≥ 7% (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 7.41, 95% confidence interval [CI] 3.50-15.65), while SGLT2 inhibitor therapy was associated with lower odds of albuminuria (aOR 0.54, 95% CI 0.30-0.95). Absence of statin-containing therapy was associated with higher odds of LDL cholesterol ≥ 100 mg/dL (aOR 6.01, 95% CI 3.38-10.66). Absence of statin-containing therapy was associated with higher odds of residual LDL cholesterol ≥ 100 mg/dL (aOR 4.21, 95% CI 2.34-7.58). Seventy-two percent of participants presented at least three persistent cardio-renal-metabolic abnormalities, while 24.2% exhibited five or more. More than half of participants with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, heart failure, or chronic kidney disease were not receiving either an SGLT2 inhibitor or a GLP-1 receptor agonist.
CONCLUSIONS: Significant residual cardio-renal-metabolic risk persists in adults with T2DM despite use of contemporary pharmacological therapies. Disease severity markers and treatment exposure were associated with persistent adverse outcomes, but the cross-sectional design does not establish causality. The study identified potentially modifiable therapeutic gaps among patients with established cardiovascular and renal disease. Comprehensive and repeatedly reassessed cardio-renal-metabolic management, integrating pharmacological optimization with individualized risk stratification, may improve implementation of guideline-directed therapy and reduce long-term complications in routine clinical practice.
items.authors: Petca Bianca-Lăcrimioara, Popovici Paula-Alexandra, Igna Andreea Diana, Ghitea Timea Claudia, Popoviciu Mihaela Simona
items.summary_ja: ルーマニアの専門外来糖尿病クリニックを受診した2型糖尿病（T2DM）成人232例を対象とした横断観察研究。通常の外来診療における薬物治療パターンを評価し、継続治療下での残存心・腎・代謝リスクを同定し、持続的な不良アウトカムの独立関連因子を多変量ロジスティック回帰で解析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 最新の薬物療法（SGLT2阻害薬、GLP-1受容体作動薬、スタチン）を使用しているにもかかわらず、72%の参加者に3つ以上の持続的心・腎・代謝異常が認められ、24.2%には5つ以上が認められた。確立した動脈硬化性心血管疾患・心不全・慢性腎臓病を有する参加者の半数以上がSGLT2阻害薬またはGLP-1受容体作動薬のいずれも投与されていなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: ルーマニアの通常の外来診療において、ガイドライン推奨治療の実装ギャップと残存リスクの負荷が十分に特徴付けられていなかった。本研究は、確立した心血管・腎疾患を有する患者における潜在的に修正可能な治療ギャップを特定し、包括的かつ反復的に再評価される心・腎・代謝管理の必要性を示した。
items.study_type_ja: 横断観察研究（実世界、外来）
items.endpoints_ja: ['薬物治療パターン（降糖薬・スタチン等の処方率）', '残存心・腎・代謝リスク（血糖・脂質・腎機能・肥満・血圧の目標未達）', '持続的な不良アウトカムの独立関連因子（多変量ロジスティック回帰）', '累積残存リスクカウント（7つの未管理リスク因子の合計）']
items.sample_size_ja: 232例（ルーマニアの専門外来糖尿病クリニックを受診したT2DM成人）

items.title: Semaglutide Remodels the Gut Microbiome Beyond Its Appetite-Suppressing Action: Sex-Specific Gut-Brain Axis Implications.
items.abstract: The gut microbiome communicates bidirectionally with the brain and peripheral metabolic organs to regulate appetite and body weight. Semaglutide (SEMA), a GLP-1 receptor agonist, produces robust weight loss by reducing food intake, largely through brain GLP-1 receptors, yet whether its effects on the gut microbiome are secondary to this centrally driven hypophagia is poorly understood. Given the profound impact of SEMA on food intake and body weight, we propose that SEMA treatment reshapes gut microbial composition and that these shifts are correlated with metabolic outcomes. Diet-induced obese rats received a 4-week SEMA treatment and gut microbial composition was analyzed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. To differentiate the impact of reduced food intake associated with SEMA from other effects of the drug treatment on the gut microbiome, a pair-fed to SEMA group was tested. SEMA significantly reduced body weight gain and food intake in both sexes. Significant SEMA-induced changes in microbial richness and evenness were detected. Linear discriminant analysis Effect Size (LEfSe) identified enrichment of Firmicutes taxa-particularly members of the Clostridiaceae family-in SEMA-treated rats, whereas controls showed greater representation of Bacteroidota taxa. Sex-specific associations between host metabolic parameters and gut microbial composition were also identified. These findings demonstrate profound, not necessarily health positive, partly sex-specific gut microbial community shifts following GLP-1 analogue treatment. Many of the changes in the gut microbiota were not simply driven by the decreased food intake. Thus, GLP-1 analogue treatment engages the gut microbiome through both food intake-dependent (brain-to-gut) and intake-independent pathways.
items.authors: Byun Suyeun, Sotzen Morgan R, Bento Madison T, Knappenberger Mya A, Asker Mohammed, Wright Justin R, Lamendella Regina, Mu Chunlong
items.summary_ja: 食事誘発性肥満ラットに4週間セマグルチド（SEMA）を投与し、16S rRNA遺伝子配列解析により腸内微生物叢の組成を解析した。SEMA群の食事量に合わせたペアフィード群を設け、食事量減少に伴う効果と薬剤の他の効果を区別した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1アナログ投与により、食事量減少に単純に起因しない、性差を伴う腸内微生物叢のシフトが認められた。GLP-1アナログは食事量依存性（脳→腸）と非依存性の両経路で腸内微生物叢に影響を与える。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の食欲抑制作用とは独立した腸内微生物叢への影響を解明することで、これらの薬剤の作用機序の全体像や潜在的な副作用の理解に寄与する。
items.study_type_ja: 動物実験（食事誘発性肥満ラット、16S rRNA遺伝子配列解析による腸内微生物叢解析）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重増加、食事量、微生物の多様性（richness）と均一性（evenness）、腸内微生物組成（16S rRNA遺伝子配列解析）、宿主代謝パラメータと腸内微生物組成の性差関連

items.title: Poly(vinyl alcohol) dissolving microneedles for transdermal semaglutide delivery and anti-obesity therapy in rats.
items.abstract: Semaglutide is an effective anti-obesity peptide, but repeated subcutaneous injections may reduce its acceptability for long-term therapy. We prepared semaglutide-loaded poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA) dissolving microneedles (Sema-MNs) by sequential vacuum-assisted molding and room-temperature drying. The 15 × 15 arrays concentrated Cy5-labelled semaglutide toward the needle tips, resisted axial compression, penetrated rat skin, and partially dissolved within 5 min; skin barrier function approached baseline within 4-6 h. Sema-MNs contained 29 ± 2 μg semaglutide per patch, with an apparent delivered amount of 18 ± 2 μg (63 ± 3%; n = 3), and released more than 90% of the Sema-Cy5-associated cargo within 30 min. In high-fat-diet-induced obese rats, once-daily Sema-MN treatment for 7 days reduced food intake and body weight. Treatment also decreased adipocyte size and hepatic lipid accumulation, improved glucose tolerance and serum metabolic indices, and reduced hypothalamic neuropeptide Y immunofluorescence relative to the disease and unloaded-microneedle controls. No evident renal biochemical or major-organ histopathological abnormalities were observed during the study. These findings support the feasibility of a compositionally simple, rapid-release PVA microneedle system for transdermal semaglutide administration.
items.authors: Cheng Xueqing, Wang Fei, Liu Hongwei, Li Feifei, Li Tongle, Liu Chaoyong
items.summary_ja: セマグルチドを充填したポリビニルアルコール（PVA）溶解型マイクロニードル（Sema-MNs）を、逐次真空補助型成形と室温乾燥により調製した。15×15配列のマイクロニードルはCy5標識セマグルチドを針先に濃縮し、軸方向圧縮に耐え、ラット皮膚を貫通し、5分以内に部分的に溶解した。皮膚バリア機能は4〜6時間でベースラインに接近した。Sema-MNsはパッチあたり29±2μgのセマグルチドを含み、見かけの投与量は18±2μg（63±3%；n=3）であり、30分以内にSema-Cy5関連カゴの90%以上を放出した。高脂肪食誘導肥満ラットにおいて、1日1回のSema-MN投与を7日間行ったところ、食物摂取量と体重が減少した。また、脂肪細胞サイズと肝臓の脂質蓄積が減少し、グルコース耐量と血清代謝指標が改善し、視床下部のニューロペプチドY免疫蛍光が疾患対照群および無充填マイクロニードル対照群と比較して減少した。研究期間中に明らかな腎生化学的異常や主要臓器の組織病理学的異常は観察されなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 組成が単純で速放出型のPVA溶解型マイクロニードルシステムにより、セマグルチドの経皮投与が実現可能であり、高脂肪食誘導肥満ラットにおいて抗肥満効果（体重減少、食物摂取量減少、肝臓脂質蓄積減少、グルコース耐量改善）が示された。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチドは有効な抗肥満ペプチドであるが、反復的な皮下注射は長期治療の受容性を低下させる可能性がある。本マイクロニードルシステムは、皮下注射に代わる経皮投与経路として、患者のコンプライアンス向上に寄与する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床動物実験（ラットを用いた薬理学的・安全性評価）
items.endpoints_ja: 食物摂取量、体重、脂肪細胞サイズ、肝臓脂質蓄積、グルコース耐量、血清代謝指標、視床下部ニューロペプチドY免疫蛍光、腎生化学パラメータ、主要臓器組織病理学、皮膚バリア機能、投与量、放出率
items.sample_size_ja: 投与量測定：n=3。肥満ラット群のサンプルサイズは抄録に記載なし。

items.title: Outcomes after Posterior Cervical Spine Surgery: A Matched Cohort Analysis and Comparison of GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Use and Bariatric Surgery in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND CONTEXT: Obesity and diabetes can increase perioperative risk, especially in posterior cervical spine surgery. Bariatric surgery provides durable weight loss but carries surgical and nutritional risks, while glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are non-surgical alternatives that may optimize weight and metabolic status preoperatively. Evidence evaluating GLP-1 therapy in spine surgery is limited.
PURPOSE: To evaluate associations between preoperative GLP-1 RA use and perioperative, short-term, and long-term complications following posterior cervical spine surgery in patients with type 2 diabetes, including comparisons to matched controls and patients with prior bariatric surgery.
STUDY DESIGN: Retrospective database analysis.
PATIENT SAMPLE: Patients with type 2 diabetes treated with metformin undergoing posterior cervical spine surgery between 2010 and 2023 were identified in the PearlDiver Mariner database. Patients were stratified into GLP-1 users, non-GLP-1 controls, and patients with prior bariatric surgery.
OUTCOME MEASURES: Physiologic measures included perioperative outcomes and postoperative complications assessed at 90 days and 2 years, including pneumonitis, surgical site infection, revision surgery, readmission, nutritional deficiency, and other medical and surgical complications.
METHODS: The PearlDiver Mariner database was queried for eligible patients. Propensity-score matching adjusted for baseline cohort differences. Outcomes included perioperative, 90-day, and 2-year complications, with BMI-stratified analyses conducted within the matched GLP-1 and control cohort. Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction was applied for multiple comparisons.
RESULTS: GLP-1 users demonstrated lower odds of perioperative complications, including pneumonitis (OR 0.57; 95% CI 0.43-0.75; p <0.001). At 90 days, GLP-1 users experienced reduced odds of surgical site infection (OR 0.72; 95% CI 0.65-0.80; p <0.001), revision surgery (OR 0.33; 95% CI 0.29-0.36; p <0.001), readmission (OR 0.82; 95% CI 0.76-0.90; p <0.001), and other complications. At 2 years, GLP-1 users had lower odds of revision surgery (OR 0.31; 95% CI 0.28-0.34; p <0.001), nutritional deficiency (OR 0.62; 95% CI 0.59-0.66; p <0.001), and other complications. Exploratory BMI-stratified analyses suggested similar directional trends across overweight and obese patients. Comparisons to prior bariatric surgery patients showed no significant differences.
CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative GLP-1 RA use was associated with reduced perioperative, short-term, and long-term complications following posterior cervical spine surgery in patients with type 2 diabetes. When compared with a matched bariatric surgery cohort, no significant differences in postoperative outcomes were observed. These findings should be interpreted in the context of potential residual confounding and support further prospective investigation of GLP-1 therapy as a strategy for preoperative metabolic optimization in posterior cervical spine surgery.
CLASSIFICATIONS: Cervical Spine, Outcomes Research, Risk Factors, Perioperative Complications.
items.journal: The spine journal : official journal of the North American Spine Society
items.authors: Rivera Nicole, Bradley Taylor, Crowell K A, Goodwin C Rory, Erickson Melissa
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病を有しメトホルミン治療下で後方頸椎手術を受けた患者を対象に、術前GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）使用と術周期・短期（90日）・長期（2年）合併症との関連を、傾向スコアマッチングを用いた後ろ向きデータベース解析で評価した。GLP-1 RA使用群は非使用対照群と比較して術周期合併症（肺炎）、90日時点の手術部位感染・再手術・再入院、2年時点の再手術・栄養欠乏症のオッズが有意に低かった。過去の肥満手術群との比較では有意差は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 2型糖尿病を有する後方頸椎手術患者において、術前GLP-1 RA使用は術周期・短期・長期合併症のリスク低減と関連していた。肥満手術群との比較では有意差は認められなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満・糖尿病は後方頸椎手術の術周期リスクを高めるが、GLP-1 RAは非外科的な術前代謝最適化戦略として有望であり、肥満手術と同等のアウトカムを示唆する結果は、手術リスクの高い患者群における術前管理の選択肢を拡大する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向きデータベース解析（PearlDiver Marinerデータベース）
items.endpoints_ja: 術周期合併症（肺炎）、90日時点の手術部位感染・再手術・再入院・その他合併症、2年時点の再手術・栄養欠乏症・その他合併症

items.title: Association between SGLT2 inhibitor use and functional outcomes in elderly patients receiving ferric carboxymaltose: a retrospective observational cohort study.
items.abstract: Anemia and iron deficiency (ID) are extremely common comorbidities in elderly patients with chronic heart failure (CHF), and are associated with reduced functional capacity and worse prognosis. The objective of this study was to evaluate the association of one-year therapy with SGLT2i as add-on to intravenous infusion of ferric carboxymaltose (FCM) with improvement in functional abilities, in a cohort of elderly patients with HFrEF/HFmrEF with ID anemia. This study enrolled outpatients with CHF with ID anemia receiving intravenous administration of FCM and stratified into two groups according to SGLT2i use. The study endpoint was an achievement of Short physical performance battery (SPPB)>8pt at one year of follow-up. 222 patients, with a mean age of 75.5±6.0 years were enrolled and 53 received SGLT2i while 169 not. After 1 year of follow-up, a significant improvement in the main clinical, laboratory, echocardiographic and CGA parameters were observed in both groups; however, these improvements were statistically greater in those patients receiving also SGLT2i. The mean dose of FCM administered to the entire population at baseline was 734.2 ± 331.7 mg, with no significant differences between the two groups (p=0.475). Add on therapy with SGLT2i was associated with a greater improvement in functional abilities (OR 7.66; CI 95% 3.70-15.9, p<0.0001), while the presence of obesity was associated with a reduced probability of functional abilities improvement of 68% (OR 0.32; CI 95% 0.14-0.71, p=0.005). In patients with CHF and ID anemia, improvements in clinical symptoms and physical function were observed at one-year follow-up, as reflected by changes in SPPB scores. These improvements were greater among patients receiving concomitant SGLT2i therapy.
items.authors: Armentaro Giuseppe, Pastura Carlo Alberto, Marino Domenica Maria, Severini Giandomenico, Maruca Francesco, Condoleo Valentino, Miceli Sofia, Maio Raffaele
items.summary_ja: 慢性心不全（CHF）を伴う鉄欠乏性貧血の老年患者において、静脈内フェリックカルボキシマルトース（FCM）投与にSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）を併用した1年間の治療が機能能力の改善と関連するかを評価した後ろ向き観察コホート研究。HFrEF/HFmrEFを伴うID貧血の外来患者222例（平均年齢75.5±6.0歳）をSGLT2i使用の有無で2群に分類し（SGLT2i群53例、非SGLT2i群169例）、1年後のSPPB>8ptの達成を主要エンドポイントとした。1年後に両群で臨床・検査・心エコー・CGAパラメータの有意な改善が認められたが、SGLT2i併用群で統計的に大きな改善が観察された。SGLT2iの併用は機能能力の改善と有意に関連し（OR 7.66; 95% CI 3.70-15.9, p<0.0001）、肥満の存在は機能能力改善の確率を68%低下させたと関連した（OR 0.32; 95% CI 0.14-0.71, p=0.005）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CHFを伴う鉄欠乏性貧血の老年患者において、FCM静脈内投与にSGLT2iを併用することで、1年後の機能能力（SPPB>8pt達成）の改善が有意に高かった。
items.why_matters_ja: 貧血と鉄欠乏は老年CHF患者に極めて多く、機能能力の低下と予後不良と関連する。本研究は、FCM治療にSGLT2iを併用することで機能予後のさらなる改善が期待できることを示唆し、老年CHF患者の包括的マネジメントに示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き観察コホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: 1年後のShort physical performance battery（SPPB）>8ptの達成
items.endpoint_results_ja: SGLT2i併用は機能能力の改善と関連：OR 7.66; 95% CI 3.70-15.9, p<0.0001。肥満の存在は機能能力改善の確率を68%低下：OR 0.32; 95% CI 0.14-0.71, p=0.005。ベースライン時のFCM平均投与量：734.2±331.7 mg（両群間に有意差なし、p=0.475）。

items.title: Decoding the Safety Profile of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists: Facts, Myths, and Ongoing Controversies.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) represent one of the most significant therapeutic advances in the management of type 2 diabetes and obesity. As their indications have expanded to include cardiovascular and kidney disease, safety concerns involving multiple organ systems have received increasing attention. This narrative review examines the spectrum of adverse effects linked to GLP-1RAs and provides a clinically relevant platform for assessing their safe prescription.
RECENT FINDINGS: Gastrointestinal intolerance, modest increases in heart rate, and a modest but reproducible increase in the risk of gallbladder and biliary disease represent the most consistently supported adverse effects of GLP-1RAs. A risk of pancreatitis is also considered to exist, although some studies have challenged this association. Conversely, correlations with neuropsychiatric and dermatological disorders, diabetic retinopathy, nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, perioperative aspiration, sexual and reproductive disturbances, sarcopenia, and malignancy remain controversial. Most available evidence derives from pharmacovigilance databases, retrospective observational studies, and secondary analyses of randomized trials, which are limited by reporting bias, residual confounding, and inability to establish causality. Heterogeneity in study design, statistical methodology, outcome definitions, and patient populations further complicates interpretation. Although several proposed adverse effects have biologically plausible mechanisms, prospective clinical validation remains limited. Notably, recent regulatory decisions, including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA)'s removal of the suicidality warning from GLP-1RA prescribing information, reflect the evolving nature of these safety assessments. The overall benefit-risk profile of GLP-1RAs is favorable. Most emerging safety concerns should currently be regarded as hypothesis-generating signals rather than established toxicities. Individualized risk assessment and appropriate clinical monitoring remain important as ongoing and future prospective studies further define the long-term safety of this rapidly expanding therapeutic class.
items.authors: Kounatidis Dimitris C, Vallianou Natalia G, Kouveletsou Marina, Kontrafouri Paraskevi, Stamatopoulos Vasileios, Rebelos Eleni, Diakoumopoulou Evanthia, Dalamaga Maria
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RAs）の安全性プロファイルを叙述的にレビューしたものである。2型糖尿病および肥満の治療におけるGLP-1RAsの重要な治療的進歩を認めつつ、心血管疾患や腎疾患への適応拡大に伴い、多臓器系にわたる安全性懸念が注目されている。消化管不耐性、心拍数の軽度上昇、胆嚢・胆道疾患リスクの軽度だが再現性のある上昇が最も一貫して支持される有害事象として挙げられ、膵炎リスクについては存在するとされるが一部研究でこの関連が疑問視されている。神経精神疾患、皮膚疾患、糖尿病性網膜症、非動脈炎性前部虚血性視神経症、術後誤嚥、性・生殖障害、サルコペニア、悪性腫瘍との関連は依然として論争的である。利用可能な証拠の多くは薬物警戒データベース、後向き観察研究、ランダム化試験の二次解析に由来し、報告バイアス、残存交絡、因果関係の確立不能という限界がある。FDAによる自殺性警告の削除など、最近の規制上の決定は安全性評価の進化を反映している。全体として、GLP-1RAsのベネフィット・リスクプロファイルは良好であり、多くの新興の安全性懸念は現時点では仮説生成シグナルとして扱うべきである。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RAsの全体としてのベネフィット・リスクプロファイルは良好であり、多くの新興の安全性懸念は確立された毒性ではなく、仮説生成シグナルとして扱うべきである。消化管不耐性、心拍数の軽度上昇、胆嚢・胆道疾患リスクの軽度上昇が最も一貫して支持される有害事象である。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1RAsの適応が2型糖尿病・肥満から心血管疾患・腎疾患へと拡大しており、多臓器系にわたる安全性懸念が臨床現場で増大している。本レビューは、薬物警戒データベースや観察研究に由来する証拠の限界（報告バイアス、残存交絡、因果関係の確立不能）を明示し、個別化リスク評価と適切な臨床モニタリングの重要性を強調することで、安全な処方判断の臨床的基盤を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的レビュー（Narrative Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 消化管不耐性、心拍数上昇、胆嚢・胆道疾患リスク、膵炎リスク、神経精神疾患、皮膚疾患、糖尿病性網膜症、非動脈炎性前部虚血性視神経症、術後誤嚥、性・生殖障害、サルコペニア、悪性腫瘍との関連
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値結果の記載なし。定性的な記述のみ：消化管不耐性・心拍数の軽度上昇・胆嚢・胆道疾患リスクの軽度だが再現性のある上昇が最も一貫して支持される有害事象。膵炎リスクは存在するとされるが一部研究で関連が疑問視されている。神経精神疾患・皮膚疾患・糖尿病性網膜症・非動脈炎性前部虚血性視神経症・術後誤嚥・性・生殖障害・サルコペニア・悪性腫瘍との関連は論争的。

items.title: Oral Versus Injectable Incretin-Based Anti-Obesity Therapies: An Integrated Computational and Evidence-Based Comparison of Orforglipron, Semaglutide, and Tirzepatide.
items.abstract: Incretin-based agents are transforming obesity pharmacotherapy, and orforglipron, the first oral non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist to complete phase 3 testing, invites direct comparison with the injectable agents semaglutide and tirzepatide. We integrated clinical trial evidence, including the direct head-to-head SURMOUNT-5 trial, independently verified molecular descriptors, a fully specified drug-target-disease network with permutation-tested hub significance, hypergeometric pathway enrichment, and multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) across four weighting schemes with formal sensitivity analysis. Tirzepatide produced significantly greater weight loss than semaglutide under randomized, head-to-head conditions (20.2% vs. 13.7% at week 72) and ranked highest under balanced, efficacy-, and safety-dominant MCDA models once a composite ADMET score misapplied to two large peptides was removed. Orforglipron's lipophilicity exceeds the Lipinski ceiling, showing that its oral absorption reflects deliberate chemistry rather than default small-molecule developability; it nonetheless ranked highest under an accessibility-dominant model driven by oral feasibility and manufacturing scalability. These rankings were stable under Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis for three of four weighting schemes, with the balanced model comparatively fragile. Tirzepatide's cardiovascular evidence has also advanced, with SURPASS-CVOT reporting non-inferiority to dulaglutide. No single agent dominates every criterion; treatment selection should match the clinical priority the individual patient weights most heavily.
items.journal: Omics : a journal of integrative biology
items.authors: Sahu Lorika, Nayak Laxmipriya, Tripathy Aakankshya, Ramachandiran Sivaramakrishnan, Gunasekaran Baranika, Lokaiah Tejasri
items.summary_ja: インクリチン系薬剤は肥満症薬物療法を転換しており、第3相試験を完了した初の経口非ペプチドGLP-1受容体作動薬であるオルフォグリプロンは、注射製剤のセマグルチドおよびtirzepatideとの直接比較が求められている。本研究では、SURMOUNT-5試験を含む臨床試験エビデンス、独立検証済み分子記述子、パーミュテーション検定によるハブ有意性を伴うdrug-target-diseaseネットワーク、ハイパージオメトリック経路エンリッチメント、および4つの重み付けスキームと正式な感度分析を伴う多基準意思決定分析（MCDA）を統合した。Tirzepatideはランダム化直接比較条件下でセマグルチドより有意に大きな減量効果を示し（72週時点で20.2% vs 13.7%）、複合ADMETスコアを2つの大型ペプチドに誤適用したものを除去した後、バランス型・効果優位・安全性優位のMCDAモデルで最高順位となった。オルフォグリプロンの脂溶性はLipinskiの上限を超えており、その経口吸収はデフォルトの小分子開発性ではなく意図的な化学設計を反映しているが、経口実現性と製造スケーラビリティに駆動されるアクセシビリティ優位モデルでは最高順位となった。これらの順位は4つの重み付けスキームのうち3つでMonte Carlo感度分析下で安定し、バランス型モデルは比較的脆弱であった。Tirzepatideの心血管エビデンスも進んでおり、SURPASS-CVOTでデュラグルチドに対する非劣性が報告された。単一の薬剤がすべての基準で優位ではなく、治療選択は個々の患者が最も重視する臨床的優先事項に合わせるべきである。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Tirzepatideは直接比較条件下でセマグルチドより有意に大きな減量効果（72週時点で20.2% vs 13.7%）を示し、バランス型・効果優位・安全性優位のMCDAモデルで最高順位となった一方、オルフォグリプロンは経口実現性と製造スケーラビリティに優れるアクセシビリティ優位モデルで最高順位となった。単一の薬剤がすべての基準で優位ではなく、治療選択は患者の臨床的優先事項に合わせるべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 経口非ペプチドGLP-1受容体作動薬（オルフォグリプロン）と注射製剤（セマグルチド、tirzepatide）の統合的比較により、減量効果、心血管安全性、経口実現性、製造スケーラビリティ等多面的な基準に基づく治療選択の根拠が提供される。特に、MCDAによる多基準比較は、単一のendpointでは判断できない薬剤選択の臨床的優先順位付けに寄与する。
items.study_type_ja: 統合的計算・エビデンスベース比較（臨床試験エビデンス統合、分子記述子解析、drug-target-diseaseネットワーク解析、経路エンリッチメント、多基準意思決定分析）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少率（72週時点）、心血管アウトカム（SURPASS-CVOTにおけるデュラグルチドに対する非劣性）、MCDA総合順位（バランス型・効果優位・安全性優位・アクセシビリティ優位の4モデル）
items.endpoint_results_ja: Tirzepatide: 72週時点で20.2%の体重減少。セマグルチド: 72週時点で13.7%の体重減少。SURPASS-CVOT: デュラグルチドに対する非劣性を報告（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。オルフォグリプロンの具体的な減量数値は抄録に記載なし。

items.title: Adverse oral effects of GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonists: a scoping review protocol.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) and dual incretin receptor agonists such as glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1)/glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) are increasingly being prescribed for type 2 diabetes and obesity due to their efficacy in glycaemic control, weight loss and cardiovascular risk reduction. Emerging pharmacovigilance data suggest potential oral adverse effects, including xerostomia, dysgeusia, oral hypoesthesia and throat discomfort. Therefore, alterations in salivary function may compromise oral homeostasis and increase susceptibility to dental caries, periodontal inflammation and mucosal irritation. Additionally, metabolic and inflammatory changes mediated by GLP-1 and GIP may indirectly affect oral tissues. However, current evidence remains limited and inconsistently reported. Further research is needed to investigate the prevalence, underlying mechanisms and clinical significance of oral manifestations associated with GLP-1RA and GLP-1/GIP dual receptor agonist medications, as well as to explore the need for individualised management strategies and more frequent monitoring for patients receiving these therapies.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This protocol describes the methodology for a future scoping review to be conducted in accordance with the JBI reporting guidelines. Studies addressing incretin-based medications and their implications for oral health will be eligible for inclusion in the review, with no restrictions on language or publication date. The following databases will be searched: Cochrane, LILACS, PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus and Web of Science. Additional literature will be identified through Google Scholar and ProQuest Dissertations & Theses Global. The snowballing technique and consultation with experts in the field will be used to identify additional relevant studies. The findings will be presented through a narrative synthesis, supported by tables, graphs and maps. When data are available, exploratory comparisons will be performed according to therapeutic indication (type 2 diabetes or obesity) and pharmacological class (GLP-1RAs and GLP-1/GIP dual receptor agonists), with particular attention to tirzepatide and other incretin-based agents, to explore potential differences in reported oral manifestations. In particular, studies involving different GLP-1RA and GLP-1/GIP dual receptor agonists agents (eg, semaglutide, liraglutide and tirzepatide) may be compared to explore potential differences in reported oral manifestations. These comparisons will be conducted descriptively, considering variations in dosage, treatment duration and pharmacological class when such information is reported.
REGISTRATION DETAILS: This protocol has been registered prospectively on the Open Science Framework (DOI:10.17605/OSF.IO/NWTCS).
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: This scoping review protocol does not require ethics approval, as it only describes the methodological aspects of a future scoping review and uses secondary data from previously published studies. The findings of the review will be disseminated through publication in a peer-reviewed journal and presentations at scientific conferences. As this study is a protocol for a scoping review and does not involve human participants or identifiable data, ethics committee approval was not required.
items.authors: Escudero Samaniego Doménica Gabriela, Falconí Tarapués Melany Abigail, Cañarte Vergara Bianca Taíz, Coelho Manuella Salm, De Magalhães Gonzaga Maria de Fátima, Stefani Cristine Miron, Gonçalves Thais Marques Simek, De Luca Canto Graziela
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）およびGLP-1/GIP二重受容体作動薬の口腔内有害事象（口渇、味覚異常、口腔内知覚鈍麻、のどの不快感）に関するスコーピングレビューのプロトコル論文。JBI報告ガイドラインに準拠し、Cochrane、LILACS、PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science等のデータベースを検索対象とし、治療適応（2型糖尿病または肥満）および薬理学的クラス（GLP-1RAとGLP-1/GIP二重受容体作動薬）による探索的比較を行う計画を記述している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 本論文はスコーピングレビューのプロトコルであり、インクレチン系薬剤に関連する口腔内有害事象の疫学、機序、臨床的意義を将来のレビューで体系的に整理する方法論を提示している。結果は含まれない。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1RAおよびGLP-1/GIP二重受容体作動薬は2型糖尿病・肥満治療で増加傾向にあり、薬物警戒データから口渇・味覚異常等の口腔内有害事象が示唆されている。唾液機能の変化は口腔恒常性を損ない、う蝕・歯周炎・粘膜刺激の感受性を高める可能性があるが、現在のエビデンスは限定的かつ一貫性がなく、さらなる研究が求められている。
items.study_type_ja: スコーピングレビュープロトコル
items.endpoints_ja: 本論文はプロトコルであり、臨床試験のエンドポイントは設定されていない。将来のレビューで対象とする口腔内有害事象（口渇、味覚異常、口腔内知覚鈍麻、のどの不快感）の頻度・機序・臨床的意義が探索対象とされている。

items.title: Exploring heterogeneous treatment effects for GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with type 2 diabetes.
items.abstract: Understanding treatment effect heterogeneity (TEH) is essential to improve care for patients living with chronic diseases like type 2 diabetes. Individual responses to treatment can vary substantially, and identifying the factors that drive TEH may enable increased personalization of treatment and follow-up. In this study, we conduct an exploratory analysis of TEH for glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists used to treat type 2 diabetes. Endpoints are defined using hemoglobin A1c measurements, body mass index, and blood pressure. We use causal forests to conduct global tests for TEH, estimate variable importances to rank candidate effect modifiers, and estimate the magnitude of heterogeneity. Data from three clinical trials are analyzed: SUSTAIN 6 (subcutaneous semaglutide versus placebo, n=3297), PIONEER 6 (oral semaglutide versus placebo, n=3183), and LEADER (subcutaneous liraglutide versus placebo, n=9340), pooled to 13,670 patients after exclusions. Baseline hemoglobin A1c ranks highest among candidate effect modifiers across methods, and kidney function ranks next in the relative risk causal forest; we discuss their clinical implications. The magnitude estimates, however, show that the variation these covariates jointly explain is small. As such, large covariate-driven heterogeneity can be ruled out in these trials, and the average treatment effect provides a reasonable summary for most patients.
items.authors: Keele Luke, Bonvini Matteo, Storås Andrea M, Shirvaikar Vik, Li Haodong, Jørgensen Nils B, Salsali Afshin, Medici Morten
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬による2型糖尿病治療における治療効果の異質性（TEH）を探索的に分析した研究。SUSTAIN 6（皮下注射セマグルチド vs プラセボ、n=3297）、PIONEER 6（経口セマグルチド vs プラセボ、n=3183）、LEADER（皮下注射リラグルチド vs プラセボ、n=9340）の3つの臨床試験データをプールし（除外後13,670例）、因果森林を用いてTEHの全体検定、効果修正因子の重要度ランキング、異質性の大きさを推定した。エンドポイントはヘモグロビンA1c、BMI、血圧で定義。ベースラインHbA1cが最も重要な効果修正因子としてランクインし、次いで腎機能が上位に位置した。しかし、これらの共変量が共同で説明する変動は小さく、これらの試験では大きな共変量駆動の異質性は排除可能であり、平均治療効果が大多数の患者にとって合理的な要約であることが示された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: これらのGLP-1受容体作動薬の試験において、大きな共変量駆動の治療効果の異質性は排除可能であり、平均治療効果が大多数の患者にとって合理的な要約となる。
items.why_matters_ja: 慢性疾患患者のケア改善には治療効果の異質性の理解が不可欠であり、TEHを駆動する因子の同定は治療やフォローアップの個別化を可能にする可能性がある。

items.title: Safety outcomes of semaglutide by chronic kidney disease severity in the FLOW trial.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: People with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) often experience medication intolerance and side effects that worsen with lower estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR). This prespecified secondary analysis assessed the safety of semaglutide by baseline eGFR.
METHODS: FLOW (NCT03819153) was a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial testing the efficacy of subcutaneous semaglutide 1.0 mg once-weekly on a primary kidney outcome (50% or more eGFR reduction, kidney failure, or death due to kidney or cardiovascular causes) in participants with T2D and CKD. Safety data were collected selectively and included serious adverse events (SAEs), AEs leading to treatment discontinuation, and prespecified AEs of special interest (AESIs). In this descriptive assessment, systematically collected safety data were reported numerically by baseline eGFR.
RESULTS: Of 3533 participants, 1767 received semaglutide and 1766 received placebo. Fewer SAEs were reported with semaglutide than placebo across baseline eGFR subgroups (45.1% versus 50.4% in the 60 or more ml/min per 1.73 m2 subgroup, and 56.4% versus 60.4% in the under 30 ml/min per 1.73 m2 subgroup). SAEs related to infections and infestations; cardiac disorders; respiratory, thoracic and mediastinal disorders; and metabolism and nutrition disorders were generally less frequent with semaglutide than placebo, regardless of baseline eGFR. Treatment discontinuations due to AEs were higher with lower baseline eGFR across treatment groups (60 or more ml/min per 1.73 m2: semaglutide 11.2%, placebo 11.3%; under30 ml/min per 66 1.73 m2: semaglutide 18.8%, placebo 18.7%). Discontinuations specifically due to gastrointestinal AEs were reported more frequently with semaglutide (4.5%) than placebo (1.1%), regardless of baseline eGFR. Frequencies of AESI were similar between treatment groups across baseline eGFR subgroups.
CONCLUSIONS: In this safety assessment, SAEs were reported less frequently with semaglutide than placebo, with corresponding patterns observed for treatment discontinuations and AESIs. No unexpected safety concerns were identified across the spectrum of eGFR represented in the FLOW trial.
items.authors: Tuttle Katherine R, Andersen Margit R, Arici Mustafa, Arslan Ecenur Guder, Bellary Srikanth, Idorn Thomas, Ji Linong, Kamenov Zdravko
items.summary_ja: FLOW試験（NCT03819153）の事前指定された二次解析であり、2型糖尿病（T2D）と慢性腎臓病（CKD）を有する参加者において、ベースラインeGFRによるセマグルチドの安全性を評価した。二重盲検・ランダム化・プラセボ対照試験で、皮下投与セマグルチド1.0 mg週1回の腎臓主要アウトカム（eGFR 50%以上の低下、腎不全、腎臓または心血管原因による死亡）に対する有効性を検証した。本解析では、重篤な有害事象（SAE）、有害事象による治療中止、事前指定された特別関心有害事象（AESI）をベースラインeGFR別に記述的に報告した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチド群はプラセボ群よりSAEの報告頻度が低く、eGFRの全範囲にわたり予期しない安全性上の懸念は認められなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: T2DとCKDを有する患者では、eGFRの低下に伴い薬剤不耐性や副作用が悪化することが多く、CKD重症度別の安全性評価は臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 二重盲検・ランダム化・プラセボ対照試験（FLOW試験）の事前指定された二次解析（記述的安全性評価）
items.endpoints_ja: 本解析の安全性評価項目：重篤な有害事象（SAE）、有害事象による治療中止、事前指定された特別関心有害事象（AESI）。原試験の主要アウトカム：eGFR 50%以上の低下、腎不全、腎臓または心血管原因による死亡。
items.endpoint_results_ja: SAE：eGFR 60 ml/min/1.73 m²以上群でセマグルチド45.1% vs プラセボ50.4%、eGFR 30 ml/min/1.73 m²未満群でセマグルチド56.4% vs プラセボ60.4%。有害事象による治療中止：eGFR 60 ml/min/1.73 m²以上群でセマグルチド11.2% vs プラセボ11.3%、eGFR 30 ml/min/1.73 m²未満群でセマグルチド18.8% vs プラセボ18.7%。消化管有害事象による中止：セマグルチド4.5% vs プラセボ1.1%（ベースラインeGFRに関わらず）。AESI：ベースラインeGFRサブグループを横断して治療群間で頻度が類似。

items.title: Dose-Response Profiles in Incretin and Multi-Agonist Obesity Pharmacotherapy.
items.abstract: Incretin and multi-agonist therapies have transformed obesity pharmacotherapy, but dose selection remains less mature than efficacy assessment. This critical narrative review examines nonlinear relationships among administered dose, systemic exposure, weight and cardiometabolic benefit, gastrointestinal tolerability, treatment persistence, and maintenance. Across established and newer programs, average efficacy generally increases with dose, yet incremental gains may narrow at higher exposure while adverse-event burden and discontinuation can increase. The maturity of evidence is heterogeneous, and later-stage programs should not be interpreted as clinically equivalent to agents supported mainly by earlier-phase dose-ranging data. Moreover, an "optimal dose" is not an endpoint-independent quantity: the exposure most appropriate for weight loss may differ from that relevant to glycemic control, cardiovascular benefit, body composition, tolerability, or maintenance. We therefore distinguish nominal dose from exposure and present response-guided titration as a hypothesis-generating framework for prospective testing, not as an evidence-based dosing algorithm. Existing continuation and withdrawal studies support the importance of ongoing pharmacological treatment after successful weight loss but do not establish a minimum or optimal de-intensified maintenance dose. Future trials should jointly model efficacy, safety, body composition, patient-reported outcomes, pharmacokinetics, and discontinuation to test objective-specific, patient-level dosing strategies.

items.summary_ja: インクレチンおよびマルチアゴニスト肥満治療薬における投与量・全身曝露・体重減少・心代謝効果・消化管耐性・治療継続性・維持療法間の非線形関係を考察した批判的ナラティブレビュー。既存および新規プログラムにおいて、平均的な有効性は一般に用量増加に伴って上昇するが、高曝露域では増分効果が縮小し、有害事象の負担と中止率が増加し得ることを指摘。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 「最適用量」はエンドポイント非依存の量ではなく、体重減少に最も適した曝露は血糖コントロール、心血管効果、体組成、耐性、維持療法に関連する曝露と異なる可能性がある。応答ガイド型漸増は仮説生成フレームワークとして提示されるが、エビデンスに基づく用量アルゴリズムではない。
items.why_matters_ja: インクレチンおよびマルチアゴニスト肥満治療薬の用量選択は、有効性評価よりも成熟度が低い。後期段階のプログラムは、主に早期段階の用量探索データに支えられた薬剤と臨床的に同等と解釈すべきではない。将来の試験では、有効性・安全性・体組成・患者報告アウトカム・薬物動態・中止を統合的にモデル化して、目的別・患者レベルの用量戦略を検証すべきである。

items.title: Finerenone: A Non-Steroidal Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonist and Its Emerging Role in Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome.
items.abstract: Cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome represents the interconnected pathophysiology of metabolic risk factors, chronic kidney disease (CKD), and cardiovascular disease, leading to multiorgan dysfunction and elevated adverse outcomes. Overactivation of the mineralocorticoid receptor (MR), via aldosterone-dependent and ligand-independent pathways, drives inflammation, fibrosis, and oxidative stress and facilitates CKM progression. Finerenone is a selective non-steroidal MR antagonist (nsMRA) that exhibits high MR affinity, has balanced cardiac and renal distribution, and minimal off-target steroidal effects, which make it mechanistically different from steroidal MRAs. Large phase 3 trials such as FIDELIO-DKD and FIGARO-DKD in type 2 diabetes with CKD, and FINEARTS-HF in heart failure (HF) with a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) > 40%, demonstrated consistent cardiorenal benefits. The prespecified FINE-HEART pooled analysis showed finerenone reduced all-cause mortality (HR 0.91, 95% CI 0.84-0.99), HF hospitalizations (HR 0.83, 95% CI 0.75-0.92), and the kidney composite outcome (HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.72-0.90), with benefits consistent across CKM components and background therapies including sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors. Recent data from FIND-CKD extend utility to non-diabetic CKD. Various guidelines incorporate finerenone as an additive therapy for patients with persistent albuminuria on maximal renin-angiotensin system inhibition (RASi) + SGLT2i. This review summarizes the MR pathophysiology in CKM syndrome, compares the mechanisms of non-steroidal versus steroidal MRAs, synthesizes clinical trial evidence, safety, and guideline-directed place in therapy, addresses implementation barriers, including cost, and outlines future research directions. Finerenone may fill a critical gap in multimodal CKM management, enabling comprehensive pillar-based therapy to mitigate residual cardiorenal risk.
items.authors: Fischer Kyle G, Beavers Craig J
items.summary_ja: 本総説は、心血管・腎・代謝（CKM）症候群における鉱質コルチコイド受容体（MR）の病態生理を整理し、非ステロイド性MRA（finerenone）とステロイド性MRAの機序を比較した。FIDELIO-DKD、FIGARO-DKD、FINEARTS-HF、FIND-CKDなどの第III相試験のエビデンスを統合し、安全性、ガイドライン上の位置づけ、実装上の障壁（コスト含む）、今後の研究課題を概説している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: FinerenoneはCKM症候群の各コンポーネントおよびSGLT2阻害薬を含む背景療法を問わず一貫した心腎保護効果を示し、多面的CKM管理における残存心腎リスク軽減のための重要なギャップを埋める可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: CKM症候群は多臓器障害と不良予後を招くが、finerenoneは最大限のRAS阻害薬＋SGLT2阻害薬投与下でも持続するアルブミン尿を有する患者に対する追加療法として各ガイドラインに組み込まれており、残存心腎リスクを軽減する包括的治療の柱となり得る。

items.title: Tirzepatide for Obstructive Sleep Apnea: Trial Evidence, Cardiometabolic Effects, and Implications for Cardiovascular Practice.
items.abstract: Obstructive sleep apnea affects approximately one billion adults worldwide and is associated with hypertension, atrial fibrillation, heart failure, and stroke. Obesity is its dominant reversible cause, yet positive airway pressure therapy splints the pharyngeal airway without addressing the adiposity that narrows it, and randomized trials have not shown that it reduces cardiovascular events. In December 2024, the United States Food and Drug Administration approved tirzepatide, a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, as the first drug for moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults with obesity. We summarize the pharmacology of tirzepatide and the anatomic basis by which weight reduction improves upper airway patency, notably reduction of tongue and parapharyngeal fat. We then review the SURMOUNT-OSA program: two parallel 52-week, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trials enrolling 469 adults with obesity and an apnea-hypopnea index of at least 15 events per hour, one conducted without positive airway pressure and one during established positive airway pressure use. Tirzepatide reduced the apnea-hypopnea index by an estimated 20.0 and 23.8 events per hour relative to placebo, with concurrent reductions in sleep apnea-specific hypoxic burden, body weight, systolic blood pressure, and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein.
items.authors: Arslan Fatima Safi, Ahmad Rimsha, Frishman William H, Aronow Wilbert S
items.summary_ja: 本稿は、2024年12月に米国FDAが肥満を伴う中等症〜重症閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸（OSA）の成人に対する初の薬剤として承認したtirzepatide（GIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬）の薬理学と、SURMOUNT-OSAプログラム（2つの並行52週二重盲検プラセボ対照第III相試験）の結果を総説する。469名の肥満成人（AHI≥15 events/h）を対象とし、PAP非使用群とPAP使用群の2試験で、tirzepatideはプラセボ対比でAHIをそれぞれ推定20.0および23.8 events/h減少させ、OSA特異的低酸素負荷、体重、収縮期血圧、高感度C反応性プロテインも同時に減少させた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Tirzepatideは肥満を伴う中等症〜重症OSAにおいて、プラセボ対比でAHIを大幅に減少させ（推定20.0〜23.8 events/h）、OSA特異的低酸素負荷・体重・収縮期血圧・hs-CRPも同時に改善した。PAPが咽頭気道を物理的に開存させるのに対し、tirzepatideは気道を狭くする肥満そのものを標的とする初の薬剤である。
items.why_matters_ja: OSAは世界で約10億の成人に影響し、高血圧・心房細動・心不全・脳卒中と関連する。肥満はOSAの主要な可逆性原因であり、PAPは気道を物理的に開存するだけで肥満を解消せず、ランダム化試験で心血管イベントの減少を示していない。Tirzepatideは舌・咽頭周囲脂肪の減少を通じて上気道通過性を改善し、肥満という根本原因に作用する初の薬剤として、心血管臨床実践に新たな選択肢を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 総説（SURMOUNT-OSAプログラムの2つの第III相二重盲検プラセボ対照試験のレビュー）
items.endpoints_ja: 呼吸時無呼吸低呼吸指数（AHI）、OSA特異的低酸素負荷、体重、収縮期血圧、高感度C反応性プロテイン（hs-CRP）

items.title: Finerenone versus Steroidal MRAs in Type 2 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease without Prior Heart Failure.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) markedly increase the risk of heart failure (HF) and death. While finerenone improves outcomes in clinical trials, real-world evidence and direct comparisons with steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) are limited. We evaluated finerenone versus steroidal MRAs (spironolactone and eplerenone) in patients without prior HF.
METHODS: Using the TriNetX platform, we conducted a retrospective multi-center observational study. We identified patients aged ≥18 years with T2D and CKD without prior HF and ischemic heart disease, who initiated MRAs after receiving a sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor as first-line therapy between 2021 and 2024 (N=3,680). Of these, 724 initiated finerenone and 1,542 initiated a steroidal MRA. After propensity score matching, each group included 551 patients. The primary outcome was all-cause death during the 18-month follow-up period; the secondary outcome was new-onset HF and renal outcome (a composite of end-stage renal disease and dialysis).
RESULTS: Over 18-month, finerenone initiation was associated with lower incidence rates of all-cause death (2.1 vs 4.5 events/100 person-years; incidence rate difference, -2.41; 95% CI, -4.38 to -0.44) and new-onset HF (6.5 vs 12.9; -6.38; 95% CI, -9.75 to -3.02), whereas no significant difference was observed for the renal outcome (8.3 vs 9.1; -0.81; 95% CI, -3.99 to 2.37).
CONCLUSIONS: Finerenone was associated with a lower 18-month risk of all-cause death compared with steroidal MRAs in patients aged ≥18 years with T2D and CKD without prior HF, who received an SGLT2 inhibitor as first-line therapy; however, residual confounding cannot be excluded, and these findings should be considered hypothesis-generating.
items.authors: Kishimori Takefumi, Kato Takao, Iwasaki Yoshihiro, Shimada Takenobu, Tani Akira, Yamaji Ryosuke, Koike Jumpei, Matsumoto Takehiro
items.summary_ja: TriNetXプラットフォームを用いた後方視的多施設観察研究。2021〜2024年にSGLT2阻害薬を第一選択治療として受けた後、MRAを開始した、既往の心不全・虚血性心疾患のないT2D合併CKD患者（N=3,680）を同定した。うちフィネレノン開始群724例、ステロイド性MRA（スピロノラクトン、エプレレノン）開始群1,542例。プロパティスコアマッチング後、各群551例で比較した。主要エンドポイントは18ヶ月フォローアップ期間中の全死因死亡、副次エンドポイントは新規心不全発症および腎アウトカム（ESRDと透析の複合）とした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: フィネレノンはステロイド性MRAと比較して、18ヶ月の全死因死亡（2.1 vs 4.5 events/100 person-years）および新規心不全発症（6.5 vs 12.9）の発生率が有意に低かったが、腎アウトカムには有意差を認めなかった。残余交絡因子を排除できず、本結果は仮説生成と位置づけられる。
items.why_matters_ja: T2DとCKDは心不全および死亡のリスクを著しく増加させるが、フィネレノンの実世界での有効性及びステロイド性MRAとの直接比較に関するエビデンスは限られていた。本研究はSGLT2阻害薬を第一選択治療として受けた患者におけるMRA選択に関する実世界比較効果データを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的多施設観察研究（TriNetXプラットフォーム、プロパティスコアマッチング）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：18ヶ月フォローアップ期間中の全死因死亡。副次エンドポイント：新規心不全発症、腎アウトカム（ESRDと透析の複合）。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 全死因死亡：2.1 vs 4.5 events/100 person-years（incidence rate difference, -2.41; 95% CI, -4.38 to -0.44）。新規心不全発症：6.5 vs 12.9（-6.38; 95% CI, -9.75 to -3.02）。腎アウトカム：8.3 vs 9.1（-0.81; 95% CI, -3.99 to 2.37）。

items.title: Early Changes in Left Atrial Mechanics During Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitor Therapy in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Conventional echocardiographic improvements after sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor therapy have been reported in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), but data on novel composite indices of atrial mechanics, particularly the left atrial (LA) stiffness index and the left atrioventricular coupling index (LACI), remain poorly characterized. The authors evaluated early changes in conventional diastolic parameters and atrial mechanics following initiation of SGLT2 inhibitor therapy.
METHODS: In this prospective, single-center observational cohort study, patients with HFpEF in sinus rhythm who were naive to SGLT2 inhibitors received empagliflozin or dapagliflozin. Clinical assessment, laboratory testing, and comprehensive echocardiography were performed at baseline and after 3 months. Echocardiographic evaluation included LA reservoir and pump strain, the LA stiffness index (E/e'/LA reservoir strain), and LACI (minimum LA volume/LV end-diastolic volume ×100).
RESULTS: Fifty patients completed follow-up (70% women; mean age, 63.9 ± 8.1 years). New York Health Association functional class improved and N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide levels decreased significantly (347 [134.8-524.8] vs. 257 [161.3-427.5] pg/mL; P = .007). Left atrial volume index and E/e' decreased significantly (34.6 ± 5.5 to 32.6 ± 5.7 mL/m2 and 12.1 ± 3.2 to 9.8 ± 2.8, respectively; both P < .001). Left atrial reservoir and pump strain increased, whereas the LA stiffness index and LACI decreased significantly (all P < .001).
CONCLUSIONS: In this prospective observational cohort of patients with HFpEF, initiation of SGLT2 inhibitor therapy was associated with early changes in conventional diastolic parameters and LA mechanics. Composite atrial indices, particularly the LA stiffness index and LACI, changed in parallel with established clinical and echocardiographic markers, suggesting that they may provide complementary information for monitoring early atrial remodeling during SGLT2 inhibitor therapy.
items.authors: Altun Selen Cansu, Özyüncü Nil, Akbulut Koyuncu İrem Müge, Tan Türkan Seda
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬未治療のHFpEF患者（洞調律）を対象とした前向き単一施設観察コホート研究。エンパグリフロジンまたはダパグリフロジンを開始し、ベースラインと3ヶ月後に臨床評価、血液検査、包括的エコー検査（LA reservoir strain、LA pump strain、LA stiffness index、LACIを含む）を実施し、SGLT2阻害薬開始後の通常の拡張能パラメータと心房力学の早期変化を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: HFpEF患者におけるSGLT2阻害薬開始は、通常の拡張能パラメータ（LA容積指数、E/e'）および心房力学（LA reservoir strain、LA pump strain、LA stiffness index、LACI）の早期変化と関連していた。LA stiffness indexとLACIは確立された臨床・エコーマーカーと並行して変化し、SGLT2阻害薬治療中の早期心房リモデリングのモニタリングに補完的情報を提供し得る。
items.why_matters_ja: HFpEFにおけるSGLT2阻害薬治療後の心房力学の複合指標（特にLA stiffness indexとLACI）に関するデータは十分に特徴付けられていなかった。これらの指標が早期心房リモデリングのモニタリングに補完的情報を提供し得ることを示唆し、HFpEFの管理における新たな評価手段として有用である可能性がある。

items.title: Real-world observational study evaluating metabolic and kidney outcomes in patients living with chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes mellitus with obesity prescribed tirzepatide.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) accelerate chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression. Tirzepatide, a dual glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor agonist, has demonstrated metabolic and potential renoprotective benefits in clinical trials. There have been limited reports of the implications of prescribing tirzepatide in a real-world cohort of patients with advanced CKD.
METHODS: This observational study includes a multi-ethnic cohort of 62 adults with CKD stages 1-5 who initiated tirzepatide indicated for T2DM with concurrent obesity in a general nephrology clinic between June 2024 and October 2025. Patients were followed for a median of 21.4 weeks. Clinical outcomes including weight, glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c), estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (uACR), blood pressure, lipid profile and insulin requirements were collected.
RESULTS: Tirzepatide significantly reduced median weight (103-100 kg; p < 0.0001), HbA1c (63 [7.9%] to 54 [7.1%] mmol/mol; p = 0.002) and uACR (111-44 mg/mmol; p = 0.008), while eGFR remained stable. Significant improvements were also observed in triglycerides, total cholesterol, LDL cholesterol and total daily insulin dose. Gastrointestinal symptoms and decreased serum bicarbonate were the most common adverse events.
CONCLUSIONS: In this real-world, multi-ethnic cohort, including patients with advanced CKD, tirzepatide was associated with clinically meaningful improvements in weight, glycaemic control, albuminuria, lipid profile and insulin requirements without adversely affecting kidney function. The introduction of tirzepatide to patients with CKD should be guided by a multidisciplinary team.

items.authors: Carruthers Jack E, Ooi Xi Yan, Goodall Dawn, Reed Jo, Bedi Rachna, McGrath Adrian, Willicombe Michelle, Avari Parizad

items.key_takeaway_ja: CKD進行期を含むreal-world多民族コホートにおいて、tirzepatideは体重、血糖コントロール、アルブミン尿、脂質プロファイル、インスリン用量の臨床的に有意な改善と関連し、腎機能に悪影響を与えなかった。
